gist: Channel disclaimer: no promotion of drugs or alcohol, content is for information and education, community guidelines followed
Namaskar and welcome to the audience

hindi: जब भी हम जीवन में कोई कार्य करते हैं तो कार्य करने से पहले हम ह्यूमन कॉन्शसनेस के द्वारा जो भी कॉस्मस से अंतरिक्ष से ईश्वर से भगवान से अपने इलेक्ट्रोमैग्नेटिक सिग्नल के द्वारा जो हम कॉलिंग करते हैं वैसा ही रिजल्ट होता है
says: Before starting any task, the intention we send out from our consciousness to the cosmos or God, as an electromagnetic signal, decides the result we get; the result matches the call we made.
ambiguity: General manifestation principle, not tied to any planet in this sentence.
classical_check: Not a classical Jyotish rule; modern manifestation framing.

gist: Story of Mona who was very worried about marriage and could not find a good boy; asks what a good boy even means

hindi: उसको उतना पता था यही अच्छा होता है इससे आगे उसे पता ही नहीं था इसलिए उसे वही अच्छा लग रहा था जो आज तक के जीवन में हमारा संस्कार होता है
says: A person's idea of 'good' is limited to their intellect and conditioning (sanskar); they cannot see beyond it, so they feel only that kind of partner is good.
ambiguity: Psychological explanation, no astrological factor named.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not discuss this.

hindi: आगे की जानकारी ना होने के कारण जो बुद्धि मांगती है वही हमारी इच्छा बन जाती है और वही हमारी लड़ाई और इस लड़ाई के कारण से हम एक ऐसा लड़का या लड़की ढूंढते रहते हैं
says: Because we lack wider knowledge, whatever the intellect asks for becomes our desire and then our stubborn fight, and we keep searching for one fixed type of boy or girl.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Mona's affairs ended in a year or two, she became frustrated; mother, neighbours, friends and others pushed her to marry; she then thought neither temple nor guru's blessing helps
She decides marriage is a nuisance to be got over with, and marries in that feeling

hindi: ऐसे कमांड देने वाले जितने भी लड़के लड़कि उनकी शादी के बाद वह शादी करने के बाद एक नपुंसक व्यक्ति से विवाह करते हैं
says: Boys or girls who give the command 'just finish this marriage nuisance' end up married to a napunsak (unproductive, impotent) partner; the starting attitude decides the partner's quality.
ambiguity: He uses 'napunsak' in a broad sense (fruitless), defined in the next sentence; not a medical diagnosis, recorded only as his claim.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical rule.

hindi: नपुंसकता का अर्थ समझ ले जिसके द्वारा पुन सत्व ना होगा या आगे की लाइफ के अंदर कोई भी पजनी नहीं बनेगी
says: His definition of napunsakta: something from which no further creation or generation will come, so nothing productive or fruitful will be built in the later life.
ambiguity: Caption garbled ('पुन सत्व', 'पजनी'); likely means no regeneration or progeny/product coming forward. Meaning inferred.
classical_check: Classical napunsaka grahas are Mercury, Saturn, (and Ketu in some texts); here he stretches the word to mean fruitlessness.

hindi: टीवी खरीद के खत्म करो वह घर में पड़ा रहता है झंझट मुका यार सोना खरीद के खत्म करना है वो लॉकर में सड़ जाता है
says: Things bought with a 'finish it off' attitude, like a TV or gold, stay unused: the TV just sits at home and the gold rots in the locker without giving any result.
ambiguity: Investment-like remark about gold, recorded only as his illustration, not advice.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मकान खरीदना ही है अब तो ढूंढ ढूंढ के पागल हो गए वह मकान खून के आंसू रुलाता है आपने किस तरह क्या सोच के कार्य की आरंभ किया है
says: A house bought in a desperate 'I must buy one now' state, after searching until mad, later makes you cry tears of blood; what mindset you started the work with decides how it ends.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब तो बस बच्चा हो जाए खत्म करो सास के तानों से दुखी हैं हम समाज कहता है नपुंसक को किसी लायक नहीं वो बच्चा खून के आंसू रुलाता है
says: A child conceived just to end the taunts of the mother-in-law and society makes the parents cry tears of blood; the same 'finish it' attitude spoils even the child.
ambiguity: Caption mixes the napunsak taunt with the child; meaning reconstructed.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शुरुआत मकान दुकान काम क्या किया है वह आपका बच्चा है यह जो नपुंसकता देता है यह देता है हमारा शनि ग्रह
says: Whatever you begin, house, shop or work, is like your child; and this fruitlessness or impotence-type result is given by Saturn.
classical_check: Agrees partly: Saturn is a napunsaka (neuter) graha in classical texts, though here he extends it to fruitlessness of all ventures.

gist: Previous class covered planets up to Venus; this class begins Saturn, a very strange planet that could take a full class, but only marriage aspects will be taken

hindi: शनि ग्रह सूर्य की संतान है यदि अंतरिक्ष में हम देखकर चले तो शनि की प्लेसमेंट बहुत पीछे की तरफ है
says: Saturn is the child of the Sun, and in the physical order of the solar system Saturn's placement is far behind, in the distant part.
classical_check: Agrees: Shani is Surya's son (Chhaya putra) in Puranic tradition.

hindi: यह शनि महाराज का पोर्टल है मूलाधार चक्र आप शनि की पोजिशनिंग देखेंगे तो सन के साथ अलाइन होने के बाद मरकरी बुध वीनस शुक्र अर्थ धरती हमारी मार्स मंगल
says: Saturn's portal in the body is the Muladhara (root) chakra; the planets line up with the Sun in order Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars and onward, with Saturn at the far end.
ambiguity: Planet order is the physical solar order, not a Jyotish rule.
classical_check: Chakra-planet mapping is modern (Saturn to Muladhara is common in modern texts); silent in Parashari classics.

hindi: जुपिटर यह गुरु ग्रह है जो हमारे नाभि के ठीक नीचे हमारे वाटर चक्र को कवर अप करता है यही मेनिफेस्टेशन का इलाका है और इसके ठीक आगे है शनि
says: Jupiter covers the water chakra just below the navel, which is the zone of manifestation, and directly beyond it comes Saturn.
ambiguity: Jupiter-to-water-chakra is his own mapping; Jupiter also named guru in the same breath.
classical_check: Silent in classics; Jupiter and Swadhisthana link is modern.

gist: Repeats that Saturn is considered the Sun's son
Garbled caption about legs and all the deity planets sitting; meaning cannot be recovered

hindi: यह शनि ही मूलाधार है और यह गुप्त रहता है बृहस्पति के अंधकार के पीछे
says: Saturn is the root chakra itself and stays hidden behind the darkness of Jupiter.
ambiguity: 'Darkness of Jupiter' is figurative; likely means Jupiter's position screens Saturn from view.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यानी गुरु जो है ये सूर्य के द्वारा पड़ने वाली सारी रश्मिया शनि इत्यादि को तभी पहुंचाता है अगर गुरु यानी ज्ञान नहीं हो बिना ज्ञान के मनुष्य शनि इत्यादि के ग्रहों के अंतर्गत कार्य करता है
says: Jupiter (knowledge) is the channel that carries the Sun's rays to Saturn and the outer planets; without knowledge a person simply works under the control of Saturn-type planets.
ambiguity: 'Ityadi' means he groups Saturn with the other outer planets without naming them.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter as jnana karaka is classical, the ray-channel image is his.

hindi: यह मार्ग ग्रह माने जाते हैं शनि न्याय का देवता है सजा देता है
says: These are regarded as harsh or path-forcing planets; Saturn is the god of justice who gives punishment.
ambiguity: 'मार्ग ग्रह' may be a caption error for 'मारक ग्रह' (killer/harsh planets); uncertain.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn as Dandadhikari and giver of karmic punishment is classical.

hindi: इसी का अपना भाई है प्लूटो यमराज और यह सूर्य के पुत्र हैं
says: Saturn's own brother is Pluto, identified with Yamaraj, and both are sons of the Sun.
ambiguity: Pluto-Yama identification is part of his 12-planet scheme.
classical_check: Puranas make Yama and Shani both sons of Surya; Yama is not classically a planet in the chart.

hindi: यानी कि जितने रोग होते हैं हड्डी टूटना खराब करना अचानक लॉटरी गेंस झटके से बहुत प्राप्ति हुई
says: Saturn's field covers diseases, bone fractures, spoiling or damage, and also sudden lottery-type gains, a large receipt coming in a jerk.
ambiguity: Disease and fracture are recorded only as his karakatva list, not as a diagnosis rule.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Saturn rules chronic illness, bones and sudden reversals in classical texts.

hindi: जमीन जायदाद प्रॉपर्टी मंगल सम्मिलित होता है इसमें यह सारा का सारा खेल शनि के पास है
says: Land and property are Mars-linked but included in this; the whole game of such sudden and hidden matters is in Saturn's hands.
ambiguity: Unclear whether Mars joins Saturn for property or Saturn controls Mars; sentence is loose.
classical_check: Mars is the classical karaka of land; Saturn's control is his own addition.

hindi: तो शनि क्या है दिखता ही नहीं तो जब भी शनि आपका लीडिंग प्लेनेट होगा शादी के मुद्दे के लिए शादी किससे होगी पता ही नहीं
says: Saturn is the unseen one; when Saturn is the leading planet for marriage, you will not know in advance whom you will marry.
cells_derived_method: Saturn as leading marriage planet makes the partner's identity unknown or sudden; the nature depends on which house topics Saturn rules and which sign it is in. In a sign Saturn owns it is more steady, in debilitation more erratic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in the 7th (lagna Aries) gives a late, serious, sudden-but-stable partner.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in the 7th (lagna Libra) gives the same unexpected partner but with friction and delay.

ambiguity: 'Leading planet' is not defined; he probably means the strongest planet influencing the 7th.
classical_check: Silent on 'leading planet'; Saturn delaying marriage is classical.

hindi: जब किसी भी लड़के या लड़की की कुंडली में सातवें घर में शनि कार्य करेगा स्थान पर सेवंथ हाउस घर है यह हम इसको राशि नहीं कह रहे
says: When Saturn works on the 7th house in a boy's or girl's chart, he stresses it is the 7th house (bhava), not the 7th sign.
cells_derived_method: Saturn acting on the 7th house gives delay and sudden marriage; sign changes the flavour: Capricorn or Aquarius (own) steady, Aries (debilitated) harsh, Libra (exalted) strong but late.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in own sign in 7th (lagna Cancer), marriage delayed but lasting.
Derived: Saturn in 7th in Cancer (lagna Capricorn) makes a cold or emotionally restricted partner.

classical_check: Agrees: Saturn in 7th delaying marriage is classical.

hindi: यह प्रथम हाउस है चौथा है और यह दसवा सातव घर में शनि देखेगा कहां कहा से देख सकता है शनि की दृष्टि यहां से आ सकती है शनि यहां स्थापित हो सकता है
says: Saturn can act on the 7th house from four places: the 1st, 4th, 7th and 10th; either its aspect falls on the 7th or Saturn sits there.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's real aspects on the 7th come from houses 1 (7th aspect), 5 (3rd aspect) and 10 (10th aspect), plus sitting in 7th; his list uses the four kendras. Sign decides whether the aspecting Saturn is strong.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn own sign in lagna Capricorn, 7th-aspect on Cancer 7th house.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in the 10th (lagna Cancer), its 10th aspect falls on the 7th.
Derived: Saturn exalted in 4th (lagna Cancer) does not aspect the 7th by 3-7-10 rule, so his list differs from Parashari here.

ambiguity: Caption is unclear; 'four houses' read as the kendras 1,4,7,10 because he says the first house, fourth and tenth. Saturn does not aspect the 7th from the 4th by classical aspects, so this may be a kendra-influence idea.
classical_check: Differs partly: classical Saturn aspects are 3rd, 7th, 10th, so the 4th is not an aspecting house.

hindi: उसके पश्चात चलित में शनि यहां पर यदि किसी प्रकार की पोजिशनिंग है यानी यहां बैठ के भी शनि रहा हो यहां बैठ यहां से यहां खिसक रहा हो मल्टीपल कारण बनाएगा
says: Also check the bhava chalit chart: if Saturn sits in or shifts into or out of the 7th-house area in chalit, it creates multiple causes for the same marriage problem.
cells_derived_method: A planet near a house boundary can move to the neighbouring house in chalit, so Saturn's effect on the 7th can arrive from the 6th or 8th sign position as well; the house topics add to the effect.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Virgo in 6th (lagna Aries) may shift into the 7th in chalit and add service and conflict themes to marriage.
Derived: Saturn in Scorpio in 8th (lagna Aries) may shift into 7th in chalit and add hidden or sudden themes to partner.

ambiguity: 'Multiple causes' is vague; he does not list them.
classical_check: Chalit shifting is a standard classical-modern technique; his marriage use is consistent.

hindi: इसकी सबसे बड़ी प्रॉब्लम होगी कि शादी कैसे होगी पता ही नहीं आपको हर हालत में कसम खा लो चॉइस का लड़का या लड़की मिलेगा नहीं
says: The biggest problem of Saturn on the 7th is that how marriage will happen stays unknown; he says you will definitely not get a boy or girl of your choice.
ambiguity: 'Take an oath' is rhetorical; he is claiming near-certainty.
classical_check: Classical texts speak of delay and an older or different partner, not total denial of choice; his claim is stronger.

hindi: आप मरते मर जाओ आप बुड्ढे हो के मर जाओ शादी नहीं होने देगा सारी जिंदगी नखरे करते रहो
says: If you keep making demands, Saturn will not let marriage happen even into old age; as long as you keep showing tantrums, it stays blocked.
ambiguity: Hyperbole; the real claim is the marriage is blocked while choosiness continues.
classical_check: Delay of marriage by Saturn in 7th is classical; the choosiness link is his own.

hindi: भैया तुम्हारे को शादी चॉइस के लड़के या लड़की से नहीं होगी झटके से होगी जब तक नखरे करोगे यानी चॉइस बनाओगे इंग्लिश में हिंदी में नखरे आपकी शादी
says: His standard line for such people: your marriage will not be to a chosen person, it will happen suddenly, and not as long as you keep fussing or insisting on choice.
ambiguity: Sentence continues into the next chunk ('नहीं होगी').
classical_check: Sudden marriage from Saturn is a modern reading; classical silent.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में लड़का या लड़की अत्यंत घोर एक समस्या से घूमते हैं उनके टेंपरेरी अफेयर्स होते हैं
says: In this situation the boy or girl goes through a severe problem and has only temporary affairs.
classical_check: Silent; classical gives delay, not temporary affairs.

hindi: शनि वैसे शाब्दिक बात है इसको हम क्लेम नहीं कहेंगे पर य सेक्चुअल रिलेशन करा के छुड़वा देता है इसका एक ही मकसद होता है कि शादी दूंगा तो सेक्स नहीं दूंगा सेक्स दूंगा तो शादी नहीं
says: He says, not as a firm claim but loosely, that Saturn lets a sexual relationship happen and then breaks it, with the pattern: give marriage and no sex, give sex and no marriage.
ambiguity: He explicitly says it is a verbal remark and not a claim.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्योंकि यह नपुंसकता का ग्रह है ऐसा बुध के द्वारा दोष भी है लेकिन शनि का बहुत ज्यादा विकराल रूप है इसके अंतर्गत
says: Because Saturn is the planet of napunsakta, the same defect can also come from Mercury, but Saturn's form of it is far more terrible.
ambiguity: Napunsakta used in his broad sense.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn and Mercury are both neuter grahas in classical texts.

hindi: क्योंकि य मुन्ना है आप ध्यान देख के शनि ही मुन्ना है शनि ही मूलाधार है इसी के पास हैरानी की बात देख के चलेंगे वास्तुशास्त्र में वास्तु में जो पोजिशनिंग है शनि की वो वेस्ट की है
says: Saturn is the root chakra itself, and astonishingly its position in Vastu is the West direction.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' is a caption slip for the root chakra theme from the story, probably meaning the root, not a literal child.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn rules the west in classical direction lordship.

hindi: वेस्ट डायरेक्शन में ही वरुण देवता है यानी आप मेनिफेस्टेशन कर ही नहीं सकते शनि के बिना
says: The deity Varuna also sits in the west, so you cannot manifest anything without Saturn.
ambiguity: In his scheme Varuna is Neptune; he does not name Neptune here, only the deity.
classical_check: Varuna as lord of the west is classical Vastu; the manifestation link is his addition.

hindi: इसीलिए कहा जाता है जब कुछ चाहना है कैसे चाहना है चाहा छोड़ दिया छोड़ दिया मींस डोंट चेज डोंट फॉलो शनि अंधकार का देवता
says: So it is said: want something, then let the wanting go; do not chase it and do not follow it, because Saturn is the god of darkness and works unseen.
classical_check: Silent; this is a surrender-style manifestation advice.

hindi: मालूम ही नहीं कैसे लगती है लॉटरी लॉटरी शब्द की परिभाषा क्या है अरे पता ही नहीं कैसे हो गया यार भाई साहब घर बैठे रिश्ता आ गया आपके
says: His definition of lottery: a gain that arrives without your knowing how, like a marriage proposal reaching you while sitting at home; this unknown-origin result belongs to Saturn.
ambiguity: Saturn is attached by the context of the next lines.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शनि घर बैठे जॉब देता है घर
says: Saturn gives a job while you are sitting at home, without applying or chasing; the sentence is cut off at the end of the slice.
ambiguity: Truncated caption at the end of the slice.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बैठे शादी कराता है क्या करो आलसी बन जाओ जैसे ही शनि के अ चारित्रिक गुण आप लाते हैं क्या आप सुस्त हो जाते हैं
says: Saturn arranges marriage for you while you sit at home; so the advice is to become lazy, meaning take on Saturn's slow, passive traits and stop rushing.
ambiguity: The first words continue the previous chunk's 'घर बैठे'. 'आलसी बनो' is meant as non-chasing behaviour, not literal idleness.
classical_check: Silent; behavioural remedy in his own style.

hindi: हाय कब मेरे बच्चे का एडमिशन होगा हाय कब होगा भूल जाओ शनि के द्वारा रूलिंग होगा ही नहीं
says: Anxious asking such as 'when will my child's admission happen' defeats the purpose; where Saturn is ruling the matter, forget about it and it will not happen through worry.
ambiguity: Text is conversational; the rule is that Saturn-ruled matters do not respond to anxious pursuit.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हाय कदो व्याह होएगा कदो प्यार मिलेगा कद जो मर्जी रोलो पिट लो अगर आप चेज करते रहे नहीं होगा यह होने नहीं देगा
says: However much you cry about when marriage or love will come, if you keep chasing it, Saturn will not let it happen.
ambiguity: Punjabi-style speech; meaning is clear.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Saturn as delay planet.

hindi: आप एक दिन फ्रस्ट्रेट कहेंगे स्यापा मुए यार काम खत्म होए और उसके बाद खून के आस रुलाने वाला सोफा दिलाएगा खून के आस रुलाने वाला मकान या बच्चे का विवाह इसीलिए पीछे मत पड़ो
says: Chasing leads to frustration and the 'finish it off' attitude; then Saturn hands you a sofa, house or child's marriage that makes you weep blood, so do not run after things.
ambiguity: Caption jumbled in the middle ('आपकी जिंदगी मत पड़ जाएगी'); the core advice 'do not chase' is clear.

says: If Saturn connects to the 7th house, by aspect or through the sign, the person can have multiple affairs.

hindi: यह लग्न कुंडली में होगा चलित में होगा रण भाव में होगा कुंडली में होगा और एक नई कुंडली होगी

hindi: जिसके अंतर्गत आपके यहां पर एक नंबर राशि है तो हो सकता है 12 भी काम कर रही है एक भी कर रही है और दो भी कर रही है एक के आगे पीछे दोनों कुंडलियां
