Derived: Rahu with Jupiter in 5th, teaching and child matters confused.

classical_check: Rahu-Jupiter as guru-chandal yoga is classical; agrees.

hindi: बृहस्पति के साथ यानी ज्ञान नाम की चीज नहीं कोई समझा तो सकता ही नहीं एक दूसरे को इसलिए लड़ते हैं कौन समझा सम इसे कैसे समझाए
says: With Rahu on Jupiter there is no wisdom left, nobody can explain anything to the other, so the couple keep fighting. Absence of Jupiter's counsel leads to unresolved arguments.
classical_check: Consistent with guru-chandal results.

hindi: इसे यहां प्रमुख एक 12वां घर और हमारा इवॉल्व होता है जो सेक्स लाइफ का ग्रह है साथ बैठ के एक्सपेंसेस का ग्रह है बेड पर बैठ के लड़ाई कराता है
says: Rahu involving the 12th house, the house of bed pleasures and expenses, makes the couple fight on the bed. The 12th house is read as the sex-life and expense house, so Rahu there means bedroom conflict.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in 12th: bed disputes and spending; sign shows how it plays out.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in 12th in a Venus sign, luxury spending and bed-pleasure disputes.
Derived: Rahu in 12th in a Mars sign, aggressive bedroom quarrels.

ambiguity: He says 'प्रमुख एक 12वां घर'; the caption is jumbled, meaning inferred.
classical_check: 12th as bed pleasures (shayya sukha) and expenses is classical; agrees.

hindi: यानी कि आपका राहु ग्रसित कर रहा है इस खाने को इस खाने को यहां बैठकर या यहां तो यह सपाट कह दो बेड प बैठ के लड़ते हो तुम क्योंकि बेड प बैठ के फिजिकल कार्य तो होना नहीं है तो बातें हो रही है बस गप्पे हो रही है
says: Rahu sitting in one house afflicts the neighbouring house too, so the couple only argue and gossip on the bed with no physical union. Flat statement: they fight sitting on the bed because nothing physical happens.
cells_derived_method: Rahu afflicts its own and adjacent houses (aspect or proximity); effect is strongest on 7th, 8th, 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in 8th in Moon sign, emotional talk replaces intimacy.
Derived: Rahu in 12th in a talkative sign, chatting in bed but no union.

ambiguity: 'इस खाने को' points to boxes in a drawn chart; houses not named.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: करना धरना कुछ नहीं संतति प्राप्ति के लिए बड़ी समस्या है संतान पितरों के पास और यहां गप्पे रा और केतु ड्रैगन हैड ड्रैगन टेल मिले नहीं ऐसी स्थिति के अंदर खिच खिच के
says: Children are a big problem here because progeny belongs to the ancestors' side, and with the Dragon Head and Tail not meeting there is endless friction. He links childlessness or delayed children to Rahu-Ketu affliction and weak ancestral grace.
cells_derived_method: Progeny reading is done on the 5th house; Rahu or Ketu in the 5th, or on its lord, delays children.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in 5th in a Mars sign, delay and abrupt events around children.
Derived: Rahu in 5th in Venus sign, charm without conception, ancestral blockage.

ambiguity: 'मिले नहीं' (do not meet) is unclear; may mean Rahu and Ketu not supporting, or the pair not being connected with the 5th.
classical_check: Rahu in 5th causing progeny delay and sarpa dosha for children is classical; agrees.

hindi: कुड कुड़े जीवन चलता है और जिंदगी नर्क बन जाती है राहु आपके जीवन के अंदर किसी भी हालत में पितृ कृपा लिए बिना काम नहीं करेगा
says: Life runs on grumbling and turns into hell, and Rahu will not work in your life in any condition without first receiving ancestors' grace. Rahu's favourable results are conditional on pitri kripa.
ambiguity: Whether he means Rahu will not give good results or will not act at all is unclear.
classical_check: Silent; ancestral blessing as condition for Rahu is his emphasis.

hindi: राहु का पॉइंट समझे जैसे ही चंदा मामा के सूरज को ले लेते हैं सूर्य हो गया यहां और धरती के बीच में चांद आ गया तो सूर्य दिखना बंद हो गया तो सूर्य ग्रहण लग गया इसको राहु बोलते हैं
says: Rahu's point is understood through the solar eclipse: when the Moon comes between Earth and Sun and the Sun becomes invisible, that eclipse is what he calls Rahu. So Rahu means a hiding of the Sun's light.
ambiguity: Astronomically the eclipse occurs near the nodes; he equates the eclipse with Rahu symbolically.
classical_check: Classically a solar eclipse is the Sun swallowed by Rahu; agrees as a symbol.

gist: Story of Krishna hiding the sun during the Jayadratha killing in the Mahabharata, a trick of illusion; Krishna called a god of maya.

hindi: इसका मतलब राहु ने खा लिया सूर्य को यानी आपकी बुद्धि भ्रमित हो जाती है चलना बंद हो जाता है चांद प कौन रहते हैं चांद पे सारे पितर रहते
says: So when Rahu eats the Sun your intellect becomes confused and progress halts; he adds that the ancestors live on the Moon. The Moon is placed as the abode of the pitars.
ambiguity: Caption cuts off after 'पितर रहते'; the next batch should complete the thought.
classical_check: Pitrilok on the Moon is a Puranic idea, consistent with scripture; not a chart rule.

hindi: और चंदा मामा की कृपा लेते हैं तो माता के द्वारा मिलती है मां का शरीर जब स्त्री के शरीर के अंदर मम्मी का बटन ऑन होता है कच गर्भ ठहर जाता है
says: Completing the thought from the last batch: ancestors live on the Moon, so their grace reaches you through your mother. When the woman's body has the 'mother switch' turned on, conception takes place. He links Moon, mother and pitri grace to conception.
cells_derived_method: Conception capacity is read from the Moon and the 5th house; Moon strength by sign (Taurus, Cancer strong; Scorpio weak) sets how readily the mother switch turns on.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon's own sign on the 5th, easy conception and strong maternal wish.
Derived: Moon-debilitated sign on 5th, emotional blocks around conceiving.

ambiguity: Caption begins mid-sentence, 'लेते हैं' subject is the ancestors from the previous slice.
classical_check: Moon as mother and fertility karaka is classical; pitars on the Moon is Puranic. Agrees broadly.

hindi: कई स्त्रियों का यहां कच बटन ही नहीं है मम्मी बनने की इच्छा नहीं है हो तो ऐसा हो वैसा हो नखरे हो संतान कंसीव ही नहीं होती डॉक्टर कहता है अरे रिपोर्ट सब सही है स्पर्म काउंट ठीक है एग इज ओके
says: Some women lack the mother switch, have no wish to be mothers and make demands, and conception does not happen even when the doctor says reports, sperm count and eggs are all fine. He attributes unexplained non-conception to missing ancestors' grace, not to medical causes. This is his tradition claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Unexplained infertility is derived when Rahu afflicts the Moon or 5th; sign decides whether the cause is wish, emotion or fear.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in 5th in a detached sign, no wish for motherhood and no conception despite normal reports.
Derived: Rahu with Moon in 4th in its debilitation sign, fear and emotional block against becoming a mother.

classical_check: Rahu-Moon grahan and 5th affliction for delayed children are classical.

hindi: फर्टिलिटी डेज नहीं हो रहा है क्यों पितृ कृपा नहीं है ग्रहण लगा हुआ है यह सारा राहु का खेल है इसी राहु के दोष के कारण से आपके जीवन के अंदर संतति नहीं होने देगा
says: Asked why conception does not happen when all tests are normal, his answer is missing pitri kripa and an eclipse on the chart, all Rahu's play, and Rahu's dosha blocks progeny. The rule: Rahu affliction plus missing ancestor grace stops children.
cells_derived_method: Check Rahu in or aspecting the 5th, Sun-Rahu or Moon-Rahu in the 5th or 9th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Sun's sign on 5th, eclipse effect on the child house.
Derived: Rahu in 9th in a Mars sign, ancestral blessing blocked, progeny delayed.

ambiguity: 'फर्टिलिटी डेज नहीं हो रहा है' is a garbled caption, read as 'fertility is not happening'.
classical_check: Classical sarpa dosha and pitri dosha cause progeny delay; agrees.

hindi: अब संतान का मुद्दा क्या होता है पैदा हुए थोड़ा सा छोटे एक फ्लैट में रहे पिताजी छोड़ गए थे जिंदगी भर नौकरी की बच्चे पाले पसे मर गए कुछ पैदा ही नहीं किया
says: On the purpose of children he gives a lifelong-employee example: lived in a small flat left by father, worked all his life, raised children and died having created nothing. He points out that a person should leave something for the next generation, which is the real meaning of progeny.
ambiguity: The point of the example is implied: legacy as part of the debt to ancestors.
classical_check: Silent; a moral rather than chart rule.

gist: A person should build a house, two buildings, vehicles and wealth and leave a legacy for children, as opposed to just living and dying.

hindi: लेगासी भीष्म ने अपने लिए क्या किया क्यों नहीं मिली उसे भूमि पर जगह क्योंकि उसने पितृ ऋण पूरा नहीं किया पितृ ऋण क्या है आपने क्या अपना डीएनए आगे बढ़ाया नहीं बढ़ाया यह भी दोष है
says: Using Bhishma, who found no place on earth because he did not repay pitri rin, he defines ancestral debt as passing your DNA forward. Not continuing the lineage is itself a fault.
ambiguity: The Bhishma claim is his narrative reading; the epic gives different reasons for his lying on arrows.
classical_check: Pitri rin (debt to ancestors by producing progeny) is classical Hindu doctrine; the Bhishma detail is his own telling.

hindi: तो संतति हीन रख लेता है कई बार राहु संतानी नहीं होने दूंगा ऐसी स्त्रियां जिनके विवाह नहीं हो रहे 35 40 साल की हो गई है
says: Rahu often keeps people childless, and the same Rahu is behind women of 35 to 40 whose marriages are not happening. Delayed marriage and no progeny are both put under Rahu's denial.
cells_derived_method: Late marriage when Rahu or Saturn influence the 7th or its lord; sign tells how: Capricorn or Aquarius sign 7th adds Saturn delay, Gemini or Virgo adds Mercury indecision.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Saturn's sign in the 7th, marriage deferred well past thirty.
Derived: Rahu in Mercury's sign in 7th, over-analysis and rejection of proposals.

classical_check: Rahu or Saturn in the 7th delaying marriage is classical.

hindi: अब प्रॉब्लम स्त्री की ये है कि मेनोपॉज हो गया या होने वाला है अब उसके लिए बहुत बड़ी समस्या हो गई शरीर वृद्ध हो रहा है अब उसके लिए समाज में विवाह होना बहुत आवश्यक है
says: The woman's difficulty is that menopause has come or is near and her body is ageing, so marriage has become urgent in society's eyes. He is describing the life stage when delayed marriage becomes a crisis.
ambiguity: A social observation, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मान लो शारीरिक सुख संभोग नहीं चाहिए चाहिए लेकिन संतान प्राप्ति नहीं होने दूंगा तो क्या कर रहा है ये यह घर बैठे बूढ़ा कर रहा है और किसलिए नखरे चलते हैं
says: Rahu either denies intimacy or allows desire but denies progeny, and meanwhile it keeps the person ageing at home, while the person goes on making demands about prospects. He shows how Rahu delays through choosiness.
cells_derived_method: Choosiness shows with Rahu on 7th lord or 7th; sign of 7th lord sets the type of demand.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Sun's sign on 7th, pride and high standards keep marriage away.
Derived: Rahu in Venus sign on 7th, endless comparison of suitors.

ambiguity: The caption is loose; subject of 'नखरे' is the person, not Rahu.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अल्टीमेटली क्या होगा संभोग नहीं देने देगा तो पित्रों की कृपा नहीं है इसलिए पित्र कृपा ले पितृ कृपा किस प्रकार बनेगी जबान से कचड़े गलत सुनने की
says: Ultimately lacking union means lacking ancestors' grace, so the remedy is to earn pitri kripa, and he says it is built through the tongue and ears, by what one speaks and listens to. He is introducing a conduct-based remedy.
ambiguity: Sentence breaks off at 'गलत सुनने की'; completed in the next chunk.
classical_check: Classical pitri dosha remedies are shraddha, tarpan and charity; conduct-of-speech is his own.

hindi: हम गंदा सुनते बुराई सुनते हैं कहते हैं ना किसी के बारे में बुरा नहीं बोलना खराब नहीं बोलना आशीर्वाद लो झुको फलान ढम कान किसलिए सिर्फ इसलिए राहु एक्टिवेट मत करो
says: The traditional advice of not speaking ill of anyone, taking blessings and bowing exists only so that you do not activate Rahu. He gives a Rahu-based reason for the old etiquette.
classical_check: Silent on Rahu as the reason; etiquette is traditional.

hindi: आप इमीडिएट अपने कानों से सुन के आंखों से देख मुंह से बुरा बोल आपके तरड़ दरा डाल देते हैं ह्यूमन कॉन्शसनेस में राहु खराब पित दोष स्टार्ट
says: Hearing, seeing or saying bad things immediately cracks your human consciousness, spoils Rahu and starts pitri dosha. So a pitri dosha can be self-created by habitual negativity.
classical_check: Classical pitri dosha is from birth chart and past lives; conduct-created dosha is his addition.

hindi: पित दोष को ऐसा ना समझे कि पित्र बैठे ऊपर देख रहे लो भाई क्या हो रहा फोटो खींचो नो आपका डीएनए श्रंक हो जाता है
says: Do not imagine pitri dosha as ancestors sitting up above watching and punishing. In his view it is your DNA shrinking, a self-contained biological-spiritual effect.
ambiguity: DNA shrinking is a metaphor-heavy claim, not scientific.
classical_check: Contradicts the classical view of the ancestors' curse; his reinterpretation.

hindi: लोग कहते हैं ना पूरा का पूरा ज्ञान भर लू कितनी बड़ी गागर चाहिए आपकी तब आएगा ज्ञान आप डरे हु सहमे हो बुराई कर रहे हो कुड रहे हो इतनी सी गागर इतना सा डीएनए क्या धेला भरेगा
says: To receive knowledge you need a very big vessel, but a fearful, complaining person has a tiny one with so little DNA capacity that nothing gets in. Rahu-era grace needs a large receptive capacity built by effort.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपकी गागर बहुत बड़ी होनी चाहिए बहुत बड़ी तना एफर्ट करना है राहु के टाइम पर इतना
says: Your vessel must be very large, so during Rahu time you must put in some effort. Rahu periods demand effort to expand capacity.
ambiguity: 'राहु के टाइम' could be Rahu dasha or any Rahu-sensitive period; he does not say.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: दो बैडमिंटन प्लेयर होते हैं एक बैडमिंटन प्लेयर है आपका बिल्कुल साथ खड़ा है यह नेट लगा हुआ है नेट के साथ खड़ा है दूसरा बैडमिंटन प्लेयर दूर खड़ा है शनि और राहु के टाइम क्या होगा शनि की छाया है राहु शनि का एजेंट है
says: Badminton analogy: one player stands close at the net and the other far away; in Saturn and Rahu time, Rahu is Saturn's shadow and agent and does all Saturn's work. Saturn plus Rahu periods are treated as a single combined energy.
classical_check: Rahu acting like Saturn is classical (Rahu as Saturn-like).

hindi: राहु सारे काम करता है शनि के लिए भी कैसे होगा कितना एफर्ट करना है करा छोड़ दिया तो यहां खड़ा है बंदा यहां से रैकेट से खेल रहा है यहां खड़ा है जो शनि और राहु के लिए विवाह का कार्यक्रम करे क्या करेगा
says: The person doing a marriage programme under Saturn-Rahu influence is like a player who needs only a light tap to win a point. A small effort is enough.
ambiguity: The caption mixes the demonstration of the two-player layout; only the point about small effort for marriage is clear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपको प्रयास बहुत नहीं करना आपको प्रयास बहुत थोड़ा सा करना है किसी को समझाने के चक्कर में मत रहो फालतू की किसी की क्रिया ना करो आपका राहु बिगड़ जाएगा
says: Do not over-exert; make only a little effort, do not try to convince others and do not react to anyone's needless actions, or your Rahu will spoil. Rahu is damaged by wasted arguing.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपकी कॉन्शसनेस में क्या होगा यार तू सुन नहीं रहा है तू समझता नहीं हो गया बस राहु का सत्यानाश आपके डीएनए में तरेड़ आ गई क्रश हो गया शॉर्ट एंड हो गया अगला जो डीएनए का जो कॉपी बनेगी उसमें टेलोमेरेज श्रिंक हो जाएंगे
says: Getting angry with 'you do not listen, you do not understand' ruins Rahu and cracks the DNA, and the next DNA copy will have shrunken telomeres. A biological-sounding warning about the cost of anger and nagging, offered as tradition and not as science.
ambiguity: The telomere claim is not scientifically established; recorded only as what he said.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और अगला डीएनए आपको बुढ़ापे की ओर ले जाएगा एंटीएजिंग कहां से आएगी जब आपके चेहरा देदीप्यमान होता है बहुत सुंदर तरीके से तेज झलकता है तब होता है जब आप 7080 साल के
says: Shrunken DNA pushes you toward early ageing, while anti-ageing glow on the face at 70 or 80 comes only when the Rahu-Saturn side is kept undisturbed. He ties youthful radiance in old age to the conduct he has just described.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Examples of Amitabh Bachchan's glowing face and Modi working eighteen hours, people who work with little effort at the right moment.

hindi: थोड़ा सा प्रयास आपका शनि और राहु डिस्टर्ब डिस्ट्रॉय नहीं होंगे ऐसे लोग फिर रोते हैं बैठ के यार वो बंदा ज्यादा मेहनत नहीं करता चार घंटे काम करता है इसकी लॉटरी लग गई भाई घर बैठे रिश्ता आ गया घर बैठे मकान आ गया
says: With only a little effort your Saturn and Rahu are not disturbed or destroyed, and then the marriage proposal or the house simply comes to you while others complain about their luck. Smooth gains mean Saturn and Rahu are not being provoked.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वो कौन है वो शनी और राहु डिस्टर्ब नहीं कर रहे आपने अपने किसी सेवक को तंग नहीं किए छोटे वर्कर को तंग नहीं किया है नीचे झाड़ू मारने वाले को गाली नहीं बकी है गाड़ी साफ करने वाले को नहीं बोला
says: Saturn and Rahu stay quiet for people who do not trouble servants, small workers, sweepers or car cleaners. Not harassing subordinates is given as the way to keep Saturn and Rahu undisturbed.
classical_check: Saturn as the karaka of servants and labourers; kindness to them as a Saturn remedy is classical.

hindi: नहीं आप हर एक से प्रेम से चलते हैं और कहते हैं चलो यार लीला है सब माया के खेल है छोड़ो दफा करो क्या रखा है यार आपका शनि और राहु डिस्टर्ब नहीं होगा
says: If you treat everyone with love and say it is all a play of maya, your Saturn and Rahu do not get disturbed. A detached, loving attitude is the remedy.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यही स्थिति आप अपने पति और पत्नी के साथ कहते हैं अचल कोई बात नहीं अगर दोष भी आ गया है तो व्यसन कराएगा व्यसन क्या करेगा शराब पिला सकता है शनि और राहु दोनों शराब पिला सकते हैं व्यसन करा सकते हैं
says: Apply the same attitude with your spouse: even if the dosha is present, it can bring addiction, and Saturn and Rahu can both make a person drink. He names alcohol and addiction as Saturn-Rahu results.
cells_derived_method: Addiction tendency is derived when Saturn or Rahu touches the 6th, 8th, 12th or Moon; sign sets the substance type.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in 12th in watery sign, escapism through intoxicants.
Derived: Saturn in 8th in own sign, long-running dependency habits.

classical_check: Rahu and Saturn as intoxicants and addiction is classical; agrees.

hindi: अगर ऐसा हो रहा और आप उस पर लड़ रहे हैं और तड़ डाल दी स्वस्थ शांति से चलेंगे खराब करेगा ही नहीं कहते हैं लीवर खराब हो जाता है शराब पीने से आपके शरीर में शराब गई लीवर को खा गया राहू
says: If a spouse drinks and you fight over it you worsen things, whereas staying calm keeps you healthy; Rahu eating the liver is what he says happens. This is a claim linking conflict to bodily harm and is not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: Caption is jumbled; he seems to say alcohol damages the liver through Rahu, but the sequence is unclear.
classical_check: Silent; Rahu on liver is not classical.

hindi: बृहस्पति है ये नहीं खाएगा अगर बृहस्पति ज्ञान है अवेयरनेस से चलोगे पी नहीं पी जिन्होंने शराब नहीं पी उनके भी लिवर खराब हो गए कब जब मन कुठ रहा है सड़ रहे हैं कोस रहे हैं गाली बक रहे हैं
says: With Jupiter, meaning awareness, Rahu will not eat the liver, and even teetotallers have damaged livers when their mind is bitter, rotting, cursing and abusing. His claim is that inner bitterness harms the body more than drink, offered as a tradition claim and not medical advice.
classical_check: Jupiter as liver karaka is classical; the awareness argument is his.

hindi: जितने लोग कोस रहे हैं कुड़ने हैं उनका धीरे-धीरे पैर के हिस्से से बुढ़ापा शुरू हो के शरीर निचला खराब हो जाता है वो चल फिर नहीं पाते सारे टाइम बुरा भला बोलने वालों के
says: People who keep cursing and grumbling start ageing from the feet upward, the lower body deteriorates and they cannot walk about. He links constant bad-mouthing to lower-body decay, a tradition claim and not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Planet is not named; Saturn (legs, 12th-house feet area) is a guess from the context and is not said.
classical_check: Legs and feet belong to the 12th house/Pisces and Saturn in classical body mapping; he does not cite it.

hindi: पैर गए यह गारंटी है और सूर्य को ग्रहण लगाता राहु हार्ट की प्रॉब्लम दे देगा आपको हार्ट की प्रॉब्लम किसी को भी आ सकती है मार भी सकता है परेशान भी
says: Continuing the bad-mouthing warning, he says the loss of the legs is guaranteed, and that Rahu eclipsing the Sun can give heart trouble that can distress or even kill anyone. He puts the heart under the Sun and Rahu's eclipse of it as the danger. This is a health claim of his tradition, not a diagnosis, and the mention of death is not usable as a prediction.
cells_derived_method: Heart is the 5th house and Sun; Rahu-Sun conjunction or Rahu in 5th or Leo sets the risk; the sign of the Sun decides strength.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu sitting in Leo on the 5th, eclipse on the heart house, heart strain.
Derived: Sun exalted in 4th with Rahu, chest area under an eclipse effect despite a strong Sun.

ambiguity: 'पैर गए' continues the previous chunk and is vague on whether it is a result of cursing.
classical_check: Sun and Leo for the heart and Rahu-Sun for heart trouble is a classical medical astrology association; agrees.

hindi: इसलिए कुड़ना सड़ना लड़ना नहीं हमारे साथ से कोई तेज गाड़ी से निकल गया लड़ाई शुरू पहला तो पति चिल्लाता है अरे दो गाली बकी तेरे को गाड़ी नहीं आती बीवी कहती है चुप रहो ना
says: So do not grumble, rot or fight: if a car overtakes you at speed and the husband shouts abuse while the wife says keep quiet, the better course is staying calm and not spoiling Rahu. Everyday road anger is his example of provoking Rahu.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जो दोस्त को मजाक में देते दोस्त यार को जो मजाक में गाली दे रहे वो मंगल आ गया मजाक मित्र मंगल ही अकेला है जहां राहु पंगा नहीं लेता
says: Joking abuse among friends is Mars, and Mars is the one planet where Rahu does not pick a fight. Friendly, playful banter keeps Rahu quiet.
ambiguity: This reverses the usual view of Mars-Rahu as angarak yoga, which is harmful.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat Mars-Rahu as an angarak dosha, not as a peaceful pair.

hindi: आपके जीवन के अंदर आप मित्रवत व्यवहार से चल रहे हैं पत्नी से मित्रता कम लोग करते हैं पत्नी को मित्र तो समझते ही नहीं है भाभी जी हाय ऐसे बात प्रेम से कि है बीवी से वही तो चाहिए पत्नी से मस्ती मार के गप्पे मार के चलो
says: Few men treat the wife as a friend, though they chat sweetly with a neighbour's wife; he says the same playful friendliness should be shown to your own wife. Friendship in marriage is the Mars remedy against Rahu.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यही तो हम नहीं करते मंगल आता ही नहीं राहु आ गया मु सड़ा रखा है पत्नी का मुह टेढ़ा देख के क्या क्लेश मता आदमी को मु बना रखा है
says: We do not do this, so Mars never arrives and Rahu comes in; the man keeps a sour face at the wife's twisted face and breeds quarrel. A sulky home is the Rahu pattern when Mars friendliness is absent.
ambiguity: Caption is noisy in 'क्लेश मता आदमी को मु बना रखा है'.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Jokes that the man is a drama king who says Hanuman can go to hell, while the wife's sulk would ease soon and men fight too much.

hindi: राहु की राशि छ नंबर है अपनी बहुत बढ़िया न नंबर है जहां उच्च का फल देता है बाकी सेम इसका शनि के समान स्वभाव है राशियों के अंतर्गत और राहु महाराज तीन नंबर में उच्च तो नौ नंबर में बुरे नौ नंबर किसका है बृहस्पति का या नीच फल देता है
says: Rahu's own sign is number 6 (Virgo), it gives exalted results in number 3 (Gemini), and in number 9 (Sagittarius, Jupiter's sign) it gives debilitated results; elsewhere it behaves like Saturn across signs. He gives Rahu's dignity table in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in Gemini is strong in any house: 3rd and 11th add courage and gains, 10th adds status. Rahu in Sagittarius is weak: 9th loses guidance, 5th harms children. Remaining signs follow Saturn's nature, so Rahu in Capricorn or Aquarius is stable, in Aries or Scorpio harsh.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu exalted on career house, rise through communication, media or networks.
Derived: Rahu debilitated on the dharma house in Jupiter's sign, guru and ancestor support is lost.
Derived: Rahu in own sign on the 6th, wins over rivals and sorts out disputes and debts.

ambiguity: The caption 'अपनी बहुत बढ़िया न नंबर है' is garbled; read as the exalted sign being 3, which he states directly next.
classical_check: Differs from the classical split: Rahu exalted in Taurus (some say Gemini) and debilitated in Scorpio (some say Sagittarius); Gemini and Sagittarius follows one classical school (Parashara-variant).

hindi: 12 नंबर केतु का है बहुत बढ़िया फल है एक और आठ नंबर का राहु मंगल की राशि का हो गया यह बहुत बड़ी प्रॉब्लम है काफी ज्यादा नेगेटिव फैक्ट आते है
says: Sign number 12 (Pisces) belongs to Ketu and gives very good results; Rahu in sign 1 or 8 (Aries or Scorpio, Mars signs) is a big problem with a lot of negative effects. Mars signs are hostile to Rahu in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in Aries or Scorpio is painful in all houses, worst in the 7th, 4th and 5th. Ketu in Pisces is strong, most helpful in 12th, 9th and 8th where release and spirituality pay.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in a Mars sign on the marriage house, heavy conflict and suspicion in marriage.
Derived: Ketu in own sign on the 12th, detachment, moksha-leaning life, good sleep and foreign link.
Derived: Rahu in a Mars sign on the 4th, domestic unrest and property disputes.

ambiguity: 'एक और आठ नंबर' could be signs 1 and 8 (Aries, Scorpio); read so because he calls them Mars's signs.
classical_check: Ketu in Pisces is treated well in many texts; Rahu in Mars signs as hostile is a common view.

hindi: अगला ग्रह आ गया हमारा केतु केतु है जी धुए का बादल आपने देखा है धूम केतु धुए का बादल
says: Next planet is Ketu, and he defines it as a cloud of smoke, like Dhoomketu, the comet with a smoky tail. Ketu's image is the smoky trail left behind.
classical_check: Ketu as Dhumra or smoke and comet is classical.

hindi: केतु पूंछ हनुमान जी की पूंछ केतु अग्नि यह मंगल का एजेंट है हनुमान जी मंगल नाभी पर बैठे हुए ब्रह्मचारी और उनका काम कौन कर रहा है हनुमान जी की पूंछ कर रही है
says: Ketu is Hanuman's tail and is fire, the agent of Mars; Hanuman is Mars sitting on the navel as a celibate, and the work is done by his tail. So Ketu does Mars's work and is placed at the navel area.
classical_check: Ketu behaving like Mars is classical (Ketu as Mars-like).

hindi: हनुमान जी की पूंछ ने सारी की सारी लंका की लंका लगा दी कहते हैं ना या भाई लंका लग गई अपनी तो इतना कहना ही मान लिया जाता है कि भैया इससे बुरा ना हो सके
says: Hanuman's tail set the whole of Lanka on fire, which is why we say 'my Lanka is burnt' for disaster; the saying shows Ketu's power to ruin things. Ketu is the destroyer by fire and fall-out.
classical_check: Silent; mythic illustration.

hindi: केतु क्या करता है चंद्रमा का ग्रहण लग जाता है सूर्य बीच में आ गया तो केतु यानी चंद्रमा का ग्रहण लग गया चंद्रमा दिखता नहीं है ही नहीं कहां चला गया
says: Ketu produces the lunar eclipse: when the Earth comes between Sun and Moon the Moon vanishes from sight. As Rahu eclipses the Sun, Ketu eclipses the Moon.
ambiguity: He says the Sun comes in between, though in a lunar eclipse it is the Earth that lies between; the caption may be loose.
classical_check: Classically the Moon is swallowed by Rahu or Ketu in a lunar eclipse; agrees in spirit.

hindi: इस स्थिति के अंदर केतु क्या करता है धुए का बादल इसकी एक बड़ी भारी प्रमुख ताकत है चांद के आगे बादल आ गया चांद गायब हो गया आसमान से पता ही नहीं कहां है सूरज के आगे बादल आ गया सूर्य को भी थोड़ा सा धूमिल कर
says: Ketu's main power is the smoke cloud: before the Moon it makes the Moon vanish, before the Sun it only dims it. So Ketu hides the Moon completely and dulls the Sun partly.
cells_derived_method: Moon-Ketu conjunction hides mind and emotion more than Sun-Ketu hides self-image; effects strongest in 1st, 4th, 5th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted with Ketu in 4th, a dimmed, withdrawn inner peace, odd mood.
Derived: Sun in own sign with Ketu on lagna, strong but muted ego and self-expression.

classical_check: Moon-Ketu and Sun-Ketu are classically reduced results; agrees.

hindi: देता है इतना ताकतवर है ये यह केतु की मल्टीपल दृष्टि है वरुण के बाद ये वन ऑफ द मोस्ट पावरफुल देवता है इसकी पहले घर की दृष्टि है चौथे घर की है सातवी है आठवी है नौवी भी हो गई
says: Ketu has multiple aspects and is among the most powerful deities after Varuna (Neptune); he lists its aspects as the 1st, 4th, 7th, 8th and 9th houses from where it sits. A multi-aspect Ketu is his special claim.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in house H aspects H+3, H+6, H+7 and H+8 (4th, 7th, 8th, 9th counted from itself, and the 1st is its own house). Example: Ketu in 3rd hits 6th, 9th, 10th, 11th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in 3rd aspects the 6th, 9th, 10th and 11th houses (4th, 7th, 8th, 9th from itself).
Derived: Ketu in 10th aspects 1st, 4th, 5th and 6th (counting forward and wrapping at 12).

ambiguity: 'पहले घर की दृष्टि' may mean its own house or the 1st counted from it; sign versus house counting is not stated.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give Ketu only the 7th aspect (and sometimes 5th, 9th as the nodes); this 1-4-7-8-9 set is his own.

hindi: अब इतनी सारी मल्टीपल दृष्टि होने के अंतर्गत केतु का सबसे बड़ी समस्या आती है कि किसी ना किसी तरीके से ये सातवें घर को या पांचवे को प्रभावित कर ही लेता है
says: Because of so many aspects, Ketu's biggest problem is that in some way it always touches the 7th or the 5th house. So Ketu is always involved in marriage or love and progeny.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in the 1st, 11th, 12th, 2nd, 3rd... checked with his aspect set to see which positions reach the 5th and 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu reaching the 7th gives sudden withdrawal and cooling in partnership.
Derived: Ketu reaching the 5th brings detachment and delays around children and romance.

ambiguity: With his aspect set (1-4-7-8-9) not every house reaches the 5th or 7th, so 'always' is overstated.
classical_check: Ketu in 5th or 7th is classically disturbing; the 'always' claim is his own.

hindi: केतु ग्रह की फाइट सबसे बड़ी क्या है केतु की शक्ति है अधुरी ताकत केतु का पूछ होती है ये यह हो गया केतु एक बहुत बड़ा मीटर है इसके पीछे धुए का बादल है यह जो बादल है यह केतु है
says: Ketu's power is unfinished power, the tail; he pictures it as a big meteor with a smoke cloud behind it and says that cloud is Ketu. Ketu is incomplete or residual force.
ambiguity: 'मीटर' is read as meteor (उल्का पिंड).
classical_check: Ketu as meteors and incomplete things is traditional; agrees.

hindi: मीटियर उल्का पिंड जो गिरते हैं यह धुए के बादल इसकी ना 75 पर मैक्सिमम ताकत होती है 75 पर केतु जहां पर बैठा है वहां 75 पर सातवें घर पर केतु की दृष्टि हो गई है
says: Ketu has its maximum strength at 75, which seems to mean 75 percent, and where Ketu sits it casts its aspect on the 7th house. The figure 75 is stated for Ketu's maximum aspect strength on the 7th.
cells_derived_method: Ketu's 7th aspect from any house is counted as full on the opposite house; other aspects, if any, carry lesser weight in his scheme.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in the 1st casts its strongest aspect on the 7th house.
Derived: Ketu in the 4th casts its strongest aspect onto the 10th house.

ambiguity: '75' could mean 75 percent, 75 degrees or a bad caption; no unit given. Sign number versus house also unclear.
classical_check: Silent on any 75 weight.

hindi: एक रिश्ता को तोड़ के खत्म करेगा पहले एक जगह शादी की बात बुक होकर डब्बे एक्सचेंज करके भी तोड़ देगा कोई बड़ी बात नहीं शादी के मंडप से भी उठा देगा आपके जीवन के अंदर
says: Ketu breaks relationships: a match booked and sweets exchanged can still be broken, even from the marriage mandap. Ketu afflicting the 7th causes last-minute cancellations.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in the 7th, or aspecting the 7th from the 1st, 4th, 11th or 12th by his scheme; sign sets the style of breakage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in 7th in Mars sign, sudden quarrel ends an engagement.
Derived: Ketu in 7th in Mercury sign, miscommunication cancels the match.
Derived: Ketu on lagna aspecting the 7th, self-withdrawal causes the break.

classical_check: Ketu in the 7th giving broken or delayed marriage is classical; agrees.

hindi: केतु खराब मींस ये बॉडी निचला हिस्सा आप अपनी बॉडी से गलत कर्म करने में लगे हुए हो गलत कर्म का मतलब यह नहीं होता क कर्म गलत है इसका मतलब य उसका फल गलत है
says: A bad Ketu concerns the lower body and wrong action done with the body, and 'wrong karma' here means the fruit is bad, not that the act is morally wrong. Ketu works through the limbs and punishes through consequences.
classical_check: Ketu as feet and lower body in some systems; the karma clarification is his own.

hindi: आप बे फालतू में किसी को मार बैठे किसी के बहकावे रा में आकर के आपने उसके कहने से किसी के घर चोरी कर दी खराबी कर दी उसको दुख पहुंचाया आप धुए का बादल बन के किसी के भी जाक घर में लंका लगा के आ गए अग्नि लगा दी फूट डाल दी
says: Examples of Ketu's wrong action: hitting someone for no reason, stealing at another's instigation, hurting, becoming the smoke cloud and setting another's house on fire or sowing a split. These are the offences by hand and foot that make Ketu bad.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और उस काम को करने में आपने हाथों से पैर से कुछ काम किया है सामान उठाया रखा घपले बाजी करी है अगर केतु स्ट्रांग नहीं है तो मारे जाओगे आपका केतु डिस्टर्ब डिस्ट्रॉय हो गया तो शरीर के य अंग खराब करेगा
says: If you do such acts with hands and feet, such as lifting goods or cheating, and Ketu is not strong, you will be caught or hurt, and a disturbed Ketu will damage these body parts. A weak Ketu means mishap in the limbs; he does not give a diagnosis, only a tradition link.
cells_derived_method: Ketu weakness in Gemini or Taurus signs is read as a limb-level problem on the matching house topic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Weak Ketu on the 3rd house, hands and arms prone to injury in risky acts.
Derived: Weak Ketu on the 12th, trouble with feet and legs.

ambiguity: 'मारे जाओगे' means getting caught or beaten, not a death prediction; the first part 'सबसे पहले' continues in the next lines.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सबसे पहले सारी चमड़ी केतु के पास है चंद्र केतु के दो के कारण से आपके जीवन के अंदर सारी स्किन पर निशान रश आते हैं कॉर्टिसोल नाम का हार्मोन बढ़ता है और आपको चिकते पड़ते हैं शरीर पे
says: All skin belongs to Ketu, and through the Moon-Ketu combination the skin gets marks and rashes as the cortisol hormone rises, giving patches on the body. He ties skin blemishes to Ketu with the Moon. This is his tradition claim and not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Moon-Ketu conjunction or aspect in the 1st, 6th or 8th marks skin and stress response.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign on lagna with Ketu, sensitive skin and stress rashes.
Derived: Moon debilitated on the 6th with Ketu, recurrent skin and stress-linked complaints.

ambiguity: 'चंद्र केतु के दो' is a garbled phrase, read as Moon and Ketu together.
classical_check: Skin is classically Mercury and Saturn; Ketu for skin marks is his emphasis.

hindi: लड़के और लड़किया इस चीज से परेशान है कि स्किन पर दाग है स्त्रियों के लिए विशेष तौर पर बहुत समस्या की बात यानी वो बहुत बड़ी सजा और समस्या में पर्दे का हिसाब किताब पर्दा होता है इसके पास
says: Boys and girls are troubled by skin blemishes, especially women, and Ketu also governs the veil, meaning concealment and covering. So Ketu is the skin-as-screen karaka whose faults are felt socially.
ambiguity: The 'पर्दा' sentence is garbled and could mean veil or curtain.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसे नहीं करना चाहिए वैसे नहीं करना चाहिए ऐसा करना पाप है ऐसा करना पुण्य है ऐसा करने में बुरी बात मानी जाती है जो लोग इस चीज में रहते हैं माइंड में ऐसा नहीं करना चाहिए उनको यह वाला भोग समाप्त हो जाता है
says: People who live with a head full of 'do not do this, that is sin, this is merit' lose their capacity for enjoyment (bhoga). Rigid moral rules in the mind kill Ketu's gift of pleasure.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नाभी क्या कहती है कुछ भी खिला दो नाभि के अंदर लोग क्याक नहीं डालते मुंह से खाया पूरे विश्व में क्याक नहीं खाते लोग नाभि का काम है पचा दूंगी आपने केतु डिस्टर्ब कर दिया कह दिया नहीं नहीं ये गलत चीज है
says: The navel says feed me anything, it will digest, and people eat all kinds of things worldwide; but if you disturb Ketu by declaring foods wrong, bodily enjoyment suffers. Ketu sits in the navel and digestion is its gift.
ambiguity: Whether this is a claim for diet, or a metaphor for attitude, is unclear.
classical_check: Silent; navel as Ketu or Mars seat is his scheme.

hindi: ऐसे नहीं करना चाहिए आपके शरीर में शरीर के भोग भोजन के भोग के शारीरिक संबंध के पति के पत्नी के लिए पत्नी के पति के लिए ये खत्म हो जाएंगे आपके घर के अंदर जितने भी काम अधूरे रह गए
says: If you disturb Ketu with constant prohibitions, pleasure from the body, food and marital intimacy ends for husband and wife, and many things in the home stay unfinished. Ketu disturbance means unfinished work and loss of marital pleasure.
cells_derived_method: Marital pleasure loss falls on the 7th and 8th with Ketu; unfinished work shows on the 3rd and 11th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in own sign on the 7th, spiritual distance from the spouse and fading pleasure.
Derived: Ketu on the 3rd house, projects started but never completed.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपके जीवन के अंदर जितनी चीजें अधूरी रह गई सब केतु के हवाले है क्योंकि उसका भोग नहीं हो पाएगा केतु भोग का देवता है यही केतु काबू कब होता है जब इसके साथ राहु जुड़ता है
says: Everything left incomplete in life is under Ketu because its enjoyment is never realised; Ketu is the god of bhoga, and it is brought under control only when Rahu joins it. Rahu-Ketu together settle the unfinished business.
ambiguity: The mechanism of 'Rahu joining Ketu' is not clear since nodes sit opposite; he may mean working both together via pitri grace.
classical_check: Ketu as incomplete matters is classical; the control by Rahu is his idea.

hindi: यानी आपको पित्रों की कृपा चाहिए और इस पित्र कृपा के लिए आपको गुरु चाहिए गुरु बना लो कच्चा पक्का नहीं है सूर्य बना लो सूर्य कौन हुआ गोद लिया पापा गोद ली हुई मम्मी मम्मी हुई चंद्रमा तो आपका केतु का दोष हट गया पापा हो गए सूर्य तो राहु का दोष
says: Ancestors' grace needs a guru, and if you adopt a father figure as Sun and a mother figure as Moon, Ketu's dosha is removed through the mother and Rahu's through the father. Taking guardians as substitute parents is his remedy for node faults.
ambiguity: Which of the two the mother or father removes is partly garbled; read as mother (Moon) for Ketu and father (Sun) for Rahu.
classical_check: Silent; classical remedies use Sun and Moon worship, not adopted parents.

hindi: हर व्यक्ति के पास एक माता-पिता होने चाहिए आजकल अक्सर लोग माता-पिता को लात मार देते हैं कहते भाड़ में जाओ तुम्हारी हमें जरूरत नहीं क्योंकि हमारी फ्रीडम चाहिए भोग और विलास इस केतु के कारण से
says: Every person must have a mother and father figure, but nowadays people kick parents away for freedom, luxury and indulgence, which he blames on Ketu. Rejecting parents is a Ketu symptom that damages ancestral grace.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आज समाज के अंदर स्त्रियों की रक्षा बन सकती है यह शिक्षित होना बहुत जरूरी है और केतु के मुद्दे के लिए क्या करना है दरवाजे को पैर नहीं मारो द्वार है यह द्वार
says: For Ketu's problems: women can be protected in society if educated, and one must not kick doors, because a door is a threshold. Respecting thresholds and doors is a Ketu remedy.
ambiguity: The link between women's protection and Ketu is vague in the caption.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अपने गुप्तांग बिल्कुल साफ क्लीन रखो हर हालत के अंदर शरीर में हार्मोंस चेक कराक रखो हर स्थिति के अंतर्गत आपके घर में साफ
says: Further Ketu remedies: keep the private parts perfectly clean, get hormones checked regularly, and keep the house clean. Hygiene and regular health checks are given as tradition-based Ketu care, not as medical advice from the astrologer.
ambiguity: The caption ends at 'घर में साफ'; the rest continues in the next batch.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सफाई का जितना साजो सामान झाड़ू इत्यादि वैक्यूम क्लीनर सही तरीके से रखो झाड़ू साफ सफाई करने वाले हर व्यक्ति का सम्मान करो प्रेम दो
says: Keep brooms, vacuum cleaners and all cleaning tools properly placed and respect and love every person who does cleaning work. Cleaning equipment and cleaners are placed under Ketu's care, so honouring them is a Ketu remedy.
classical_check: Silent; broom and sweepers as Saturn or Ketu matters is a common tradition.

hindi: आपने इंटेलिजेंट होकर एक वर्क दे दिया एक स्मार्ट व्यक्ति को स्मार्ट व्यक्ति ने नॉलेजेबल व्यक्ति से काम कराया उसने काम कराया स्किल्ड लेबर राहु स्किल्ड लेबर ने अनस्किल्ड लेबर एंप्लॉय की केतु बहुत सारी
says: He draws a work chain: an intelligent person hands work to a smart one, who gets it done by a knowledgeable one, then by skilled labour, which is Rahu, who employs a crowd of unskilled labour, which is Ketu. Rahu is skilled workers and Ketu the many unskilled hands at the bottom.
ambiguity: The upper links of the chain are not tied to named planets in this caption.
classical_check: Silent; Rahu and Ketu as labour classes is his scheme.

hindi: इन सबका सम्मान करो इन सबको खिलाओ पिलाओ प्रेम से रखो यह तंग करेंगे सहो नहीं सहा जाए टाटा करो कोई बात नहीं अन्यथा आपका केतु डिस्टर्ब होगा और मल्टीपल दृष्टियां देता है
says: Respect all such workers, feed them and keep them lovingly, tolerate their troubles, otherwise Ketu is disturbed and its many aspects start to hurt you. Treating helpers well is the cure for Ketu disturbance.
ambiguity: 'सहा जाए टाटा करो' is garbled; read as tolerate and part on good terms.
classical_check: Serving servants for Saturn or Ketu is a common remedy; agrees.

hindi: पति-पत्नी के बीच अधूरा संबंध हो जाएगा ऐसे बहुत से पति-पत्नी शादी के शुरुआत में एक साल दो साल बहुत अच्छा संबंध जैसे ही गर्भ ठहरा एक नए व्यक्ति का आगमन हुआ 75 पर ग्रह खिसक गया
says: Many couples have a very good bond for one or two years, but as soon as a pregnancy starts and a new person arrives, the relation turns incomplete as if the planet slipped at 75. He treats the arrival of a child as the trigger of Ketu's incomplete-relationship effect.
cells_derived_method: Child-arrival trouble is read from Ketu on or aspecting the 5th or 7th, with timing by the 5th lord's dasha.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in 5th in a Jupiter sign, cooling after the child comes, love turns to duty.
Derived: Ketu in 7th in a Venus sign, pleasure fades once family grows.

ambiguity: '75 पर ग्रह खिसक गया' repeats the unclear 75 from before; could be 75 percent strength.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पति-पत्नी में पैसे प्यार है खत्म फिर कहते हैं इस बच्चे के बाद से हमारी लाइफ में झगड़ा झंझट शुरू हो गया ये सब केतु है किसी से बदला लेने की
says: Once love between spouses ends, they say all the fighting began after the child, and he says this is all Ketu. Post-birth marital conflict is assigned to Ketu, which also brings a wish to take revenge.
ambiguity: 'पैसे प्यार' in the caption is garbled; sentence reads loosely as love finishing.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्षमता बदला लेने की इच्छा हो जाती है इसने ऐसा किया छोड़ यार दफा कर लीला है आप जितने बदले ले रहे हैं केतु पीठ पीछे पर्दा बादल बादल के पीछे से गाली बकर घटिया आदमी है
says: Ketu makes you want revenge and to abuse people from behind a veil or cloud, saying 'he is a worthless man', whereas the advice is to let go and treat it as a play. Backbiting is Ketu's way, and avenging disturbs it.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपके राहु और केतु डिस्टर्ब और डिस्ट्रॉय हो जाते हैं आपके जीवन के अंदर ग्रस जीवन के तोते उड़ जाते हैं सत्यानाश बर्बाद हो जाओगे आप
says: Spreading gossip and complaining disturbs and destroys both Rahu and Ketu, and life is wrecked. This is the combined warning of what happens when both nodes are agitated.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हमारे कर्मों के द्वारा ग्रह इन्फ्लुएंस होते हैं हमारे शरीर के अलग-अलग पोर्टल्स इसके बटंस ऑन और ऑफ होते हैं और इसी के कारण से हमारे जीवन के अंदर गृहस्थ जीवन खराब होता है
says: Our actions influence the planets, and different portals in the body have buttons that are switched on or off accordingly, which is how married life gets spoiled. Karma works on planets via body switches in his model.
classical_check: Karma-affecting-planets is general doctrine; body portals are his image.

hindi: जीवन का दो तिहाई हिस्सा शादी है और इस शादी के कारण से ही लाइफ के अंदर हमारा आगे तक का मानसिक भोग सेट होता है शादी का मतलब आप इधर-उधर भटको नहीं मुह ना मारे समाज को समाज की तरह चलाएं केतु भोग का देवता है
says: Two thirds of life is marriage, and it sets your mental enjoyment for the future; marriage means not wandering about and running society as a society. Ketu is the god of enjoyment, so its health decides this.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यही खराब हो जाए तो स्त्री के वक्ष और पुरुष का लिंग यह दोनों खराब कर देता है यानी कि लोग इस चीज से परेशान हो जाते हैं इरेक्टाइल डिस्फंक्शन हो गया
says: If Ketu goes bad it damages the woman's breasts and the man's organ, and he gives erectile dysfunction as the example of what troubles people. This is his tradition claim on Ketu and sexual organs, not a diagnosis, and only to be taken as a flag in a chart reading.
cells_derived_method: Reproductive-organ issues are mapped to the 8th, 7th and Scorpio or Libra with Ketu in them.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in 8th in a Mars sign, vulnerability of the reproductive area is flagged.
Derived: Ketu in 7th in a Venus sign, disturbed sexual vitality flagged.

classical_check: Silent on Ketu for these organs; the 8th and 7th are classical for genitals.

hindi: 48 की एज के अंदर केतु एक्टिवेट होता है 42 के अंदर राहु ऑटोमेटिक यह लाल किताब का ज्योतिष है यह भी यूनिवर्सल काम करता है आपका इस एज के बाद यदि इरेक्टाइल डिस्फंक्शन नहीं हो रहा
says: Ketu activates at age 48 and Rahu at age 42, a Lal Kitab rule that he says works universally; after these ages, if there is no erectile dysfunction, it means Ketu is kind. A Lal Kitab planetary-age scheme used as timing.
ambiguity: Lal Kitab ages for Rahu and Ketu are commonly 42 and 48, matching his numbers; the test of erectile function is a bodily marker, not a prediction to use.
classical_check: Agrees with the Lal Kitab planetary maturity ages (Rahu 42, Ketu 48); not in Parashari texts.

hindi: या सेक्सुअल लाइफ ओके है दैट मीन मी केतु की कृपा है केतु आपको जुगाड़ कराता है अपने आप शादी कैसे होगी एक जगह रिश्ता छूटेगा टूटेगा पढ़ाई कैसी होगी एक जगह पढ़ाई का एडमिशन छूटेगा टूटेगा
says: Ketu works through improvisation (jugaad): a marriage will happen by a relationship first breaking elsewhere, and a college admission will come after one admission fails. With a good Ketu, breakages lead to the final arrangement.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: टूटने दो छूटने दो बहुत अच्छा है बात चली छूट गए टूट गए फिर बादल छा गया जैसे ही बादल सा छाएगा काम होगा
says: Let things break and slip, it is good; once the talks fail and a cloud covers it, the real work happens. He gives permission to let a first match or admission fall through under Ketu.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Joking story of a girl named Mona teased about marriage who runs away, reaches Canada and lives like a queen though only fourth-pass educated.

hindi: को गुरु चाहिए ज्ञानी चाहिए गलत है राहु तो गलत राय देगा सही है तो सही राय देगा राहु सेट कब होगा जब गुरु साथ होगा बृहस्पति सेट होगा बृहस्पति सेट होगा नॉर्थ ईस्ट सेट होगा
says: Rahu needs a guru or knowledgeable person: a wrong guru gives wrong advice and a right one gives right advice, and Rahu gets set only when a guru is with you. When Jupiter is set, the north-east is set too. He links Rahu's correction to Jupiter, the guru and the north-east direction.
ambiguity: Whether 'north-east set' refers to house direction (vastu) or a chart reading is not clear.
classical_check: Jupiter as remedy for Rahu (guru) and north-east as Jupiter's direction match vastu tradition; agrees.

hindi: कोई गुरु बनाओ सीक्वेंस पूरा साइकल बनता है माता और पिता का आशीर्वाद चाहिए माता-पिता आपके खराब है आप लाइक ही नहीं करते ऐसी की तैसी नए मां बाप गोद लो पुराने वालों को काम चलाओ
says: Take a guru, then the cycle is complete with the blessing of mother and father; if your parents are bad or you dislike them, adopt new parents and manage with the old. The order is guru then parents' blessing.
classical_check: Silent on adopting parents.

hindi: पहले तो य रिलाइज करो तुम तो बेवकूफ नहीं हो उनके साथ नफरत कर रहे हो मुफ्त में माता-पिता खुद रिलाइज करें उनका पंचम भाव खराब है क्या पंचम भाव खराब होगा तो बच्चों से प्यार ही नहीं होगा
says: First realise that you hate your parents for nothing, and ask whether their 5th house is bad, because if the 5th house is afflicted there is no love toward children. A parent's afflicted 5th house explains lack of affection for their kids.
cells_derived_method: Check the parent's 5th house and 5th lord for malefics; in sign terms, a 5th in Scorpio or Capricorn with Rahu or Saturn brings coldness, in Cancer or Pisces affection survives even when afflicted.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn-sign 5th with Rahu, cold and dutiful rather than loving parenting.
Derived: Moon-sign 5th, nurturing instinct remains even with malefic influence.

ambiguity: Whose 5th house is meant (the parent's) is read from the context.
classical_check: 5th house as love and children is classical; agrees.

hindi: पत्नी से पति को पत्नी से प्रेम नहीं होगी जरूरत होगी सामाजिक दृष्टिकोण से प्यार नहीं होगा ये प्यार का खाना है
says: With a bad 5th house, a husband and wife will have need but not love, the relation being social, because the 5th house is the love box. The 5th decides whether the marriage has real love or only function.
cells_derived_method: Love versus need: warm 5th signs (Cancer, Leo, Pisces) keep affection; cold or harsh signs (Capricorn, Aquarius, Scorpio) with malefics leave a functional marriage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun-ruled 5th, affection shown strongly even under affliction.
Derived: Saturn-style 5th with Rahu, a detached, social marriage without romance.

classical_check: Agrees that the 5th stands for love and romance.

hindi: जितना भी अट्रैक्शन है जितनी पोटेंसी स्पर्म की होगी एग की होगी वो पंचम भाव से होगी यदि ये कुंडली के अंदर मैच करते हैं आपके गुण भी कम मिलते हैं शादी सफल रहेगी
says: All attraction and the potency of sperm and egg come from the 5th house, and if the two charts match here the marriage will succeed even when ashtakoot gunas match little. Gunas are subordinate to the 5th-house match.
cells_derived_method: Compare the 5th house in both charts: friendly element signs and unafflicted lords make it match.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Fire 5th in one chart matched with Leo 5th in the other, strong spark and potency.
Derived: Earth 5th against a Scorpio 5th, strong pull but heavy possessiveness.

ambiguity: Fertility terms are his tradition claim, not medical.
classical_check: Matching 5th and 7th is practised by some astrologers; ranking it over gunas is his own.

hindi: शादी सफल रहेगी किस तल पर सफल रहेगी शादी सफल रहेगी स्थल के ऊपर के संतान हो जाए शादी सफल असफल क्यों नहीं होती है क्योंकि शादी की सफलता और असफलता का क्लेश यह है ही नहीं
says: He asks at what level the marriage is successful and answers that success is judged by having children, and that success or failure is not about quarrel at all. His measure of a marriage is progeny rather than harmony.
ambiguity: Caption is jumbled; the sense 'success on the level of progeny' is inferred.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical aim of marriage as dharma and progeny.

hindi: शादी एक नीड के लिए की जाती है समाज को संतान देने के लिए की जाती है एक अच्छी संतान देने के लिए की जाती है आपकी सेक्सुअल मानसिक शारीरिक सोच वासना विकृतियां ना बन जाए इसके लिए की जाती है
says: Marriage exists for a need, to give society children and good children, and to keep sexual and mental urges from turning into perversions. A purpose-of-marriage definition in three parts.
classical_check: Consistent with traditional purposes of marriage.

hindi: जब आपका विवाह होता है तो कुंडली के अंतर्गत विवाह के लिए आपके 36 गुण होते हैं इस पर हमने मैरिज पार्ट टू क्लास की हुई है वैसे 36 गुण होते हैं 36 गुण को 100 माना जाता है
says: In chart matching there are 36 gunas, treated as 100 percent, and he says he has covered it in his Marriage Part 2 class. He sets up the ashtakoot scale before commenting on it.
classical_check: Agrees: Ashtakoot milan has 36 points in total.

hindi: एक लड़का और एक लड़की जब इनका विवाह होता है तो यह 36 हिस्से मिलाने की कोशिश की जाती है 64 तो मिलते ही नहीं है समझ लो उसी को 100 माना जाता है नाड़ी दोष वर्ण इत्यादि मैत्री तारा यह सब देखे जाते हैं
says: Match-making tries to line up 36 parts, such as nadi dosha, varna, maitri and tara, and the remaining 64 parts of the full 100 are never matched in the chart. The coverage of gunas is only about a third of what a marriage needs.
ambiguity: He reinterprets 36-as-100 as 36 of a larger 100, with 64 outside the system; the numbers are symbolic.
classical_check: Ashtakoot is classical; the '64 left out' is his argument, not from texts.

hindi: इसके अलावा बहुत बड़ी जिंदगी है 36 में से देख लेते हैं कितना मिला 64 तो भूल जाओ ना ये तो आउट इसका तो काउंटिंग ही नहीं है भाई ये तो मिलेगा ही नहीं यानी कि दो तिहाई जिंदगी में
says: Life is much bigger than the guna count, and the 64 parts are not counted at all, so two thirds of life is outside matching. Only a third is addressed by the chart match.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसे कहते थोड़ा सा मिल जाए इनका 18 गुण मिल जाए चल यार जो मिलने लायक मिलान है इसका थोड़ा सा तो मिल ही जाए अब कई लोग कहेंगे भैया 36 को 100 माना जाता है
says: He says it is enough if 18 gunas match, the usual minimum for acceptance, so at least a bit of the matchable portion fits. Eighteen of thirty-six is the threshold he accepts.
classical_check: Agrees: 18 of 36 is the classical minimum for a match.

hindi: य हमें पता है य हम एडिशनल बात कर रहे हैं या बीच में बृजेश गौतम घुसा हुआ और कुछ नहीं है यानी अपनी सोच है यह बात फैक्ट है मेरे से कल ही किसी ने पूछा कि सर आपका ज्ञान आप कितने पढ़े लिखे
says: He admits this is his own additional thinking and that Brajesh Gautam has inserted himself, and he does not claim textbook support; someone asked how educated he is. He flags the 64-versus-36 idea as personal opinion.
classical_check: He himself says this is not from classical books.

hindi: मैंने कहा करेक्शन पढ़े लिखे नहीं है हम क्योंकि जो जो बातें हम बता रहे उसकी किताब ही नहीं है कोई ये राहु केतु की राशिया और यूरेनस नेप्चून के सय तो कहीं लिखे ही नहीं ये पता नहीं कौन बता रहा है
says: He says he is not well-read because nothing he teaches is in any book: the signs of Rahu and Ketu and the roles of Uranus and Neptune are written nowhere, and he does not know who tells him. He states that his 12-planet scheme has no textual source.
classical_check: Confirms that Rahu and Ketu signs and outer planets in his scheme are not classical.

hindi: जो मुझे बताता है ना वो मेरी बॉडी यूज कर रहा है तो मेरा नहीं है तो अपना भी बस चोरी का माल है समझ लो इसलिए इसकी किताब नहीं लिखी गई है तो यह सब चीजें ऑब्जर्वेशन से आती है
says: Whoever tells him uses his body, so it is not his own and is borrowed knowledge, which is why no book is written; the material comes from observation. He credits a channelled source and observation for the unwritten parts of his system.
classical_check: Not classical; self-declared channelled and observational.

hindi: जो शास्त्रों में लिख दिया गया वो लिखने वाले ऋषि मुनि वो थे जिनके प्रिंसिपल्स बन गए यानी टाइम टेस्टेड टाइम प्रूव उन्होने कहा हा यार ये जो बोला सही बोला है ऐसे ही न नई चीजें पता लगती है समय के साथ
says: What is written in the scriptures came from sages whose principles were time-tested, and new things become known with time in the same way. He positions his findings as a continuing line of observation.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: 36 में से 18 मिला दिए जाते कहते हैं बहुत बढ़िया इससे कम ना हो इसीलिए पति पत्नी कैसे भी कुछ भी क्यों ना हो यदि ज्ञान नहीं रखेंगे तो मतभेद है ही फिर रोते रहते हैं मुझे मेरा जीवन साथी नहीं मिला
says: Eighteen out of thirty-six is called very good and nothing below, but even then spouses without knowledge will have differences and later cry that they did not get the right life partner. A matched chart still needs awareness.
classical_check: Agrees with 18 as the minimum; the awareness point is his addition.

hindi: प्रेम में भी 36 ही हिस्से अलाउड है भाई उसके अलावा अलाउड ही नहीं है 64 आपको खुद करने पड़ेंगे यह 64 आपके हाथ में है ही नहीं यह ज्ञान के पास है पति को पत्नी को 64 ये स्पेस दे के ठीक है
says: Love is allowed only 36 parts by the chart, and the other 64 must be done by you through knowledge, so spouses must give each other that space. Knowledge, not the chart, handles the remaining 64 parts of a relationship.
ambiguity: The fraction 36/64 is symbolic.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: A garbled line saying fortune is at 12 and at 72 'your Tinku' is karma done through the body; numbers and the name do not parse.

hindi: इतने काम तेरे हैं भैया मैं तेरे को इसमें डिस्टर्ब नहीं करूंगी और तू मुझे इसमें मत कर इसलिए दोनों का अपना-अपना जीवन का दो तिहाई हिस्सा ऐसा चलता है जो गुप्त होता है
says: Each spouse should leave the other undisturbed in the areas that are theirs, so two thirds of each person's life runs privately and secretly. This is the practical meaning of the 64-part space that the chart match cannot cover.
ambiguity: The caption starts mid-dialogue; the speakers are husband and wife.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सारा कुछ तुझसे ही चाहिए इंपॉसिबल प्रकृति ने ही अलाउड नहीं किया है इसलिए आपका कोई ना कोई ग्रह आप स्वयं बेवकूफी में डिस्ट्रॉय कर देते हैं
says: Expecting everything from one partner is impossible and nature does not allow it, and in trying you destroy one of your own planets through foolishness. Over-demand in marriage damages a planet.
ambiguity: No planet is named, so the damage is non-specific.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसीलिए अक्सर ये शब्द कहा गया ज्यादातर बातें मत बताओ एक दूसरे को पता ही नहीं होनी चाहिए क्योंकि वह 64 है उसमें तो तालमेल होएगा ही नहीं
says: The old advice is not to tell each other most things, since that part is the 64 where no coordination is possible. Withholding some information between spouses is advised for peace.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बाकी का भोग या विलास वो आपका इसी के पास जाएगा छत्ती गुणों के पास और इसकी मैचिंग के लिए आपके ग्रह रिस्पांसिबल है 12 ग्रह 12 राशियां और 12 भाव यही डिसाइड करके देंगे आपको कि आपके गृहस्थ जीवन की स्थिति क्या होगी
says: The rest of enjoyment goes to the 36 gunas, and the matching responsibility lies with the planets: the 12 planets, 12 signs and 12 houses together decide the state of married life. This is his statement that all three factors, not gunas alone, determine marriage.
cells_derived_method: Marriage state is read per planet in each of the 144 house-sign cells, especially the 7th house cell, its lord and Venus or Jupiter.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 7th house in a Venus sign with a benefic, easy and harmonious marriage.
Derived: 7th in a Mars sign with a malefic, passionate but conflict-ridden marriage.

classical_check: He uses 12 planets, which classical texts do not; reading the 7th house is classical.

hindi: यदि आपके सातवें घर के अंदर इतने ग्रहों की बात के बाद यह समझ पाए कि कहीं ना कहीं शादी खराब है तो इसके अंतर्गत आप क्या कर सकते हैं स्त्रियों के लिए ज्यादा बड़ी बात जरूरी शालिग्राम विवाह करो शालिग्राम
says: If after the planet discussion the 7th house shows a damaged marriage, one remedy, especially for women, is to perform a Shaligram marriage. Shaligram vivah is the first remedy offered.
ambiguity: 'एक शादी खराब कर लो' in the caption is garbled; he means a marriage that has gone wrong.
classical_check: Shaligram or Vishnu vivah as a marriage-dosha remedy appears in popular tradition; agrees with practice.

hindi: विष्णु जी का रूप है विष्णु विवाह करो ये सोने की छोटी सी टुकड़ी ले ली जाती है विष्णु जी की प्रतिमा बना लो उसमें नहीं बनी तो पंडित जी मंत्र उच्चारण के द्वारा उसके अंदर प्राण प्रतिष्ठा कर देते हैं
says: Shaligram is a form of Vishnu, so do a Vishnu marriage using a small piece of gold made into an image or, if not, the priest infuses life into it with mantras. The method of the Vishnu vivah is given.
classical_check: Prana pratishtha is standard practice; agrees.

hindi: छोटा सा टुकड़ा ले लो छोटे से का मतलब जो आपके सामर्थ्य अनुसार जिसमें श्रद्धा हो ऐसा नहीं भाई पीसा मंगाना भाई 6000 का आ रहा है मंगा लो सोना देना है देख 0 का आएगा
says: Take a small piece of gold according to your means and with faith, and do not haggle, since people order a pizza without counting but argue over a priest's fee. Spending according to capacity but without stinginess is the rule for the offering.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled in the pizza price comparison.
classical_check: Offering according to capacity (shakti anusar) is a traditional norm.

gist: Rant about people spending freely on pizza but quibbling over 1100 rupees dakshina to the priest whom they judge as rude.

hindi: नहीं देवता इस समय वो विष्णु पद प है और विष्णु मींस जुपिटर बृहस्पति की महिमा को समझ ले बृहस्पति के रहते ही राहु इत्यादि काबू होंगे यह गृहस्थ का सवाल है
says: Vishnu stands for Jupiter, so understand Jupiter's greatness: only when Jupiter is present are Rahu and the other troublemakers kept under control, and this matters for householders. He equates Vishnu with Jupiter in marriage remedies.
classical_check: Jupiter as Vishnu and as the controller of Rahu is traditional; agrees.

hindi: श्रद्धा पितरों के लिए श्राद्ध करते हैं हम वो श्रद्धा है अगर आपके मन में श्रद्धा नहीं पति या पत्नी के कर्म के प्रति तो राहु और केतु कूट देंगे प्लूटो है शनि है शक डाल देगा
says: Shraddha is the faith behind the ancestor rite, and if you lack faith in your spouse's actions then Rahu and Ketu, Pluto and Saturn will plant suspicion. Lack of trust in a spouse is the work of these four planets.
cells_derived_method: Suspicion pattern is derived when these planets touch the 7th or the Moon; sign decides whether it is secretive or cold.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu or Pluto in 7th in a secretive sign, constant doubt of the spouse.
Derived: Saturn in 7th in own sign, cold mistrust and rigid expectation.

ambiguity: 'कूट देंगे' is garbled, read as hurl or plant.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: चंद्रमा का ही दोष आएगा वहम करके शक करके पति पत्नी कहेंगे तेरा उससे अफेयर है बिगाड़ देगा यह विष्णु विवाह किया जाएगा पूर्ण श्रद्धा चाहिए
says: Moon's affliction brings delusion and suspicion, so spouses accuse each other of an affair and ruin the marriage; the Vishnu marriage is performed with full faith to counter this. Moon dosha is the root of accusations in marriage.
cells_derived_method: Moon afflicted by Rahu, Ketu or Saturn, or in Scorpio (debilitated) or in the 6th, 8th or 12th, produces suspicion.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in the 7th, jealous suspicion of the partner.
Derived: Moon in own sign on the 12th with a node, night-time fears turn into doubt.

classical_check: Moon afflicted for doubt and delusion is classical; agrees.

hindi: हम घर के अंदर जब दोष लेकर चलते हैं तो प्रथम कार्य करते हैं घर के ब्रह्म स्थान के लिए प्रणाम करते हैं उसको नैवेद्य दिया जाता है
says: When a household has a dosha, the first act is to bow to the home's Brahma sthan, the central place of the house, and offer naivedya there. The centre of the home is the first target of remedies.
ambiguity: Brahmasthan is the vastu centre of the house.
classical_check: Brahmasthan as the sacred centre is standard vastu; agrees.

hindi: जब कुछ भी समझ नहीं हम भी कई जगह फेल हो जाते हैं समझ नहीं आ रहा घर का क्या लफड़ा है तो सीधा कहते हैं थोड़ा केसर ले दूध ले और पानी हल्का सा मिला घर के ब्रह्म स्थान में रोज नैवेद्य चढ़ा
says: When the cause of a household problem cannot be found, take a little saffron, milk and a touch of water and offer it daily at the brahmasthan as naivedya. This is a general-purpose daily offering for unexplained home trouble.
classical_check: Silent on this offering.

hindi: यानी उसको प्रसाद मान और ब्रह्मा से मांग हे परमात्मा कृपा करो तुम मुझे बुद्धि दो मुझे समझ आ ठीक कैसे करना है इसलिए श्रद्धा का महत्व बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी है
says: Treat the offering as prasad and ask Brahma for wisdom to see how to set it right; faith is therefore of great importance. The prayer requested is for understanding, not for an outcome.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप शाली ग्रम विवाह कराए विष्णु विवाह कराए कन्या का यदि मंगल दोष का लफड़ा है मंगल इसके लिए कुंभ का विवाह कराए मंगल कुंभ है घड़ा शादी कर दी जाती है घड़े से शादी करने के बाद उस घड़े को फोड़ दिया जाता है
says: For a girl with a Mars dosha problem, perform a Kumbh marriage with a pot, since Mars is the pot, and break the pot after the wedding. The pot's breaking symbolises that the first husband has died and been left, so the dosha is discharged.
ambiguity: 'मंगल कुंभ है' is read as Mars's remedy being Kumbh vivah; a Kumbh could also mean Aquarius sign, but the sentence refers to the pot.
classical_check: Kumbh vivah for manglik dosha is a standard traditional remedy; agrees.

hindi: यानी एक पति मर गया छोड़ दिया खत्म किया शालिग्राम विष्णु जी कृष्ण रूप छोड़ दिया ठीक है इनको समर्पित की जा सकते हैं तुलसी विवाह किया जाता है
says: After the pot marriage the first 'husband' is considered dead and left, while Shaligram, the Krishna form of Vishnu, is left in place and Tulsi vivah can be dedicated to him. Kumbh is discarded, Shaligram is kept.
ambiguity: The caption is jumbled between the Kumbh and Shaligram sentences.
classical_check: Agrees with common practice.

hindi: जैसे विष्णु जी का विवाह तुलसी जी से करते हैं तो मल्टीपल तुलसिया उनसे विवाह हो रहा है विष्णु मींस पुरुष बॉय मेल पुरुष नहीं पुरुष अनमैनिफेस्टेड एनर्जी जो स्लीप मोड में पड़ी है
says: In Tulsi vivah Vishnu is married to many Tulsi plants; Vishnu means Purusha, not male but unmanifested energy lying in sleep mode. Vishnu is the passive principle and Tulsi the active.
classical_check: Purusha as passive consciousness and Prakriti as active matter is Samkhya doctrine; agrees.

hindi: और जो मूवमेंट की मोड के अंदर पड़ी है पैसिव और एक्टिव एनर्जी होती है जो एक्टिव एनर्जी वो आपकी हो गई प्रकृति प्रकृति चलायमान है पुरुष स्थिर है
says: Active energy in movement is Prakriti, which is mobile, while Purusha is still and passive. This pair is used to explain why the marriage rite works on the active side.
classical_check: Agrees with Samkhya.

hindi: जितने मर्जी त्याग कर दिए जाएं यह ग्रह की बलि ले लेंगे बृहस्पति सूर्य मंगल किसी भी ग्रह के दोष के लिए ये सब आप करेंगे ग्रह आउट शादी एक ही होगी सफल होगी
says: However many sacrifices are made, these remedies take the planet's offering; for a dosha of Jupiter, Sun, Mars or any planet you do the same, and then one marriage will happen and succeed. Ritual marriages to Vishnu, pot or Tulsi absorb the planet's demand.
ambiguity: 'ग्रह आउट' is garbled; read as the planet's demand being discharged.
classical_check: Silent on this generalisation across planets.

hindi: शनि के लफड़े में है वो मल्टीपल मैरिजस करता है तीन तक तो मिनिमम करा सकता है ज्यादा भी करे तो राम भरोसे वहां लफड़ा है वहां शादी करें और शादी करके पुनः कोर्ट मैरिज करें शनि के साथ शनि मुख्य है
says: With a Saturn problem the person may have multiple marriages, at least up to three, and the remedy is to marry and then marry again by court marriage; Saturn is the chief planet here. Repeating the marriage in a second form is his answer to Saturn.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's marriage trouble applies when Saturn sits in or rules the 7th; multiple-marriage claim sharper for Saturn in Aries (debilitated) or in a dual sign 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in the 7th, rocky first marriage, a second marriage likely.
Derived: Saturn in own sign on the 7th, late and steady marriage, repeat-ceremony remedy less needed.

ambiguity: The three-marriages claim is loosely stated; the legal count is not advice.
classical_check: Saturn in the 7th for delays and multiple marriages is classical.

hindi: बाकी ग्रहों का यदि सप्तम भाव में दोष आ रहा है तो अग्नि के फेरे मत करो शनि का क्या है तेल मंगल महाराज वहां आते हैं शनि के कहता है मेरा उच्च स्थान लो जी 10 नंबर राशि मंगल महाराज हनुमान जी उच्च हो जाओ
says: If other planets afflict the 7th house, avoid fire pheras; Saturn's thing is oil, and Mars comes into Saturn's sign where he is exalted, number 10 (Capricorn). Mars as fire and Saturn's house as Mars's exaltation link the fire-circling to the Saturn remedy.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Capricorn is exalted in every house, strongest in 10th and 1st. Fire pheras are advised against when the 7th house is afflicted by Saturn or Mars.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in the 10th, strong drive and status, fire energy abundant.
Derived: Mars exalted on the marriage house, heavy fire energy so the agni ritual is avoided.

ambiguity: The advice 'no fire pheras' is odd as Hindu pheras are around the fire; he means a court marriage instead.
classical_check: Mars is exalted in Capricorn, correct classically; 'no agni pheras' is not classical.

hindi: अब मंगल है अग्नि अग्नि के फेरे शनि अगर सातवें घर को रूल कर रहा है शादी करो फिर कोर्ट मैरिज करो ग्रह कहता है यार इसकी तलाक कराना है भाई प्रारब्ध है लिखा है तो हम टोटका क्या करते हैं कोर्ट भेज देते हैं
says: Mars is fire and the fire pheras, so if Saturn rules the 7th house, marry and then do a court marriage; the planet wants a divorce because it is destined, and the trick is to send the couple to court. The court marriage serves as the stand-in for a divorce the planet demands.
cells_derived_method: Saturn rules the 7th when the 7th sign is Capricorn (lagna Cancer) or Aquarius (lagna Leo). In those charts the planet's demand for separation is replaced by the court step.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer lagna with Saturn lord of the 7th, delay and cold spouse, court-step remedy applies.
Derived: Leo lagna with Saturn lord of the 7th, spouse detached, a plain second ceremony remedy applies.

ambiguity: 'Saturn rules the 7th' is read as the 7th house sign being Capricorn or Aquarius; in his scheme Pluto can also rule Aquarius. A legal procedure is mentioned, which is not legal advice.
classical_check: Silent; a popular totka and not in classical texts.

hindi: यदि पुरुष का ऐसा बैठे तो सूर्य सप्तम होने से दोष लेकर चलते हैं

hindi: लड़के को मंगली दोष नहीं होता जी लड़की को होता है सबको होता है

hindi: जब तक मंगल शनि से भंग नहीं है या अपने स्थान से डिस्प्लेस नहीं है उसके पश्चात वह शादी अलाव करेगा दोष फिर भी रहेगा

hindi: थर्ड डिवीजन में नंबर ले आया ग्रेजुएशन कर ली फिर दो साल और कुछ कर रहा है फिर एक दो कोर्स और कर लिए फिर वो पता लगा 28 29 का हो गया कर क्या रहा है कुछ नहीं पढ़ाई बहाना है
says: With Jupiter and Mercury weak or retrograde and the 5th lord in a dusthana, the child studies without result, scrapes through in third division, keeps adding courses, and by 28-29 is doing nothing; studying is only a pretext.
cells_derived_method: Result of the afflicted Jupiter, Mercury or 5th lord from the previous chunk: the 5th house (education, intellect) is weak, so the outcome depends on which dusthana holds the lord. 6th gives struggle and competition, 8th obstacles and dropouts, 12th distraction and loss.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 5th (lagna Virgo); intellect and guidance weak, drifting studies.
Derived: Mercury (own and exalted sign) in the 8th (lagna Aquarius); lots of qualifications, but results hidden or delayed.
Derived: Mercury in own sign Gemini in the 12th (lagna Cancer); mind wanders abroad or into fantasy, studies without outcome.

ambiguity: This is his story illustrating the pattern; ages 28-29 are illustrative, not a rule.
classical_check: Weak 5th lord and Jupiter in dusthanas giving poor education is consistent with the classics.

gist: When an uncle asks what he is doing he says higher studies, but he sits daily in the temple cleaning shoes, asking God for a job; ten years of knocks.

hindi: क्योंकि नखरे से पढ़ाई मेहनत नहीं करी मेहनत चोर ऊपर वाले से मांगना आया नहीं गुरु कोई बनाया नहीं किसी के बाप की
says: He gives the cause of such a life: no hard work, no idea how to ask the divine, no guru taken and no one's advice heeded; the remedy implied is effort, a guru and proper prayer.
ambiguity: Jupiter is implied through 'guru'; sentence ends mid-way and continues in the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent; behavioural reading of weak Jupiter.

gist: He listened to nobody but himself, became a shirker, time passed slowly and he keeps taking knocks.
At fifty he still runs after the bus with a small tiffin box in a bag; those running today never worked hard or took a guru.
They run with tiffins, even on cycles; their condition is an excuse in the same way.
The boy who calls everyone useless should buy his own car instead of calling others useless, and he is rejecting proposals.
Now he has a paunch and has lost hair, girls call him uncle and say he is not their type.
He makes the excuse that nothing is in marriage, the sour-grapes attitude.
We did a class on sour grapes; he tells the boy nobody asks for you.
So he makes the excuse that marriage has nothing; he told him it is sour grapes.
The excuse continues: they saw parents fighting even after 25 years.
If the parents are fools, why should you be one; become wise.
Why must you follow the same legacy; can you not improve and be better; that is a foolish line.
All this is escapism; the cup-to-lip class; nothing is in it, it is an excuse.
We got no job, no work, and then say nothing is in it; that excuse is escapism.

hindi: जो हमारा सप्तम भाव है इस सप्तम भाव के अंदर राशि के अनुसार यदि एक नंबर राशि आ रही है तो हमारे को खतरा शनि से है चंद्रमा से है
says: Check the sign in the 7th house; if sign number 1 (Aries) is in the 7th house, the danger to marriage comes from Saturn and from the Moon.
cells_derived_method: Aries in the 7th means the lagna is Libra. The danger from Saturn (debilitated in Aries) and Moon is strongest when they sit in or aspect that 7th house; the nature of the harm depends on where else they sit.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra); a cold or delayed marriage, though Saturn is yogakaraka for Libra lagna.
Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra) aspects the Aries 7th by its 10th aspect; home-duty strain falls on the marriage.

ambiguity: He says 'number 1 sign' for the 7th house; sign number, not house number, since Aries=1 is confirmed in this series.
classical_check: Saturn debilitated in Aries is classical; the Moon-as-danger in Aries is his own claim.

hindi: चंद्रमा भी नीच तुल्य है शनि तो नीच का है ही क्योंकि चंद्रमा आठ नंबर में नीच का होता है तो चंद्रमा एक नंबर में भी खराब फल ही देगा
says: In sign 1 (Aries) Saturn is truly debilitated and the Moon is treated as if debilitated; since the Moon is debilitated in sign 8 (Scorpio), he claims the Moon gives bad results in sign 1 as well.
cells_derived_method: Moon in Aries is classically a neutral-friendly sign; his rule treats signs 1 and 8 together as Mars signs where the Moon is harmful. The house decides the area: in the 10th it harms career and mother, in the 4th peace.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer); his rule makes the career emotionally unstable and the mother's support weak.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 4th (lagna Leo); home peace and mental calm damaged.

ambiguity: 'नीच तुल्य' means debilitation-like; he does not say it is classical debilitation.
classical_check: Differs from classics; Moon in Aries has no debilitation. Saturn debilitated in Aries and Moon debilitated in Scorpio are classical.

hindi: एक और आठ दोनों में ही हाईली नेगेटिव डिवास्टेटिंग फल देगा
says: The Moon gives highly negative and devastating results in both sign 1 (Aries) and sign 8 (Scorpio).
cells_derived_method: Same house-dependence as before: the harm shows in the house area where the Moon sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus); stormy emotions inside marriage.
Derived: Moon in Aries in the 12th (lagna Taurus); sleep and expenses disturbed, emotional waste.

classical_check: Moon in Scorpio is classically debilitated; Moon in Aries is not.

hindi: यह दोनों के दोनों यदि यहां बैठ जाते हैं तो इस घर का कबाड़ा है तलाक होना ही होना है आपको किसी भी हालत में
says: If Saturn and Moon both sit in this 7th house, the house is ruined and divorce is certain under any circumstances.
cells_derived_method: Saturn with Moon (Vish yoga) in the 7th. Sign 1 and sign 8 are his two bad signs for the Moon, so the pair in a 7th house of either sign is treated as severe.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn and Moon together in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra); his claim is certain divorce.
Derived: Saturn together with a Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus); same claim through the Moon's debilitation.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is read as the 7th house; 'certain' is his absolute wording, not a measured probability.
classical_check: Saturn-Moon conjunction (Vish yoga) in the 7th is classically bad for marriage; the certainty is his addition.

hindi: अगर यहां शनि चंद्र बैठा है यहां दृष्टि है शनि की यहां से दसवीं दृष्टि घूम फिर के किसी भी तरीके से तो आपका कबाड़ा होता है
says: Whether Saturn or the Moon sits in the 7th, or Saturn aspects it, including Saturn's 10th aspect from the 4th, in any way at all the marriage is ruined.
cells_derived_method: Saturn aspects the 7th by its 3rd, 7th and 10th aspects, so Saturn in the 5th, 7th or 4th hits the 7th. In his 7th-Aries case the 4th house is Capricorn.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra) casts the 10th aspect on Aries in the 7th; spouse relations pressed by home duties.
Derived: Saturn in Aquarius in the 4th (lagna Scorpio) aspects Taurus in the 7th; extends his sign-1 rule to sign 2 by analogy only.

ambiguity: The caption says 'tenth aspect from here', but the slide shows which house; I read it as the 4th.
classical_check: Saturn's 3rd, 7th and 10th aspects are classical; the 'ruin' conclusion is his.

hindi: अगर चलित में भाव में केपी कुंडली और जो हम एक्स्ट्रा कुंडली की बात कर रहे हैं उसके अंतर्गत यहां आपका एक नंबर नहीं है दो है या 12 है तो एक नंबर की पॉसिबिलिटी है

cells_derived_method: A house is multi-sign. The 7th house in chalit, KP or sign-sharing can include a share of sign 1 even when D1 shows sign 2 or 12; apply the Aries-in-7th Saturn and Moon rule in proportion to that share.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 7th in Taurus (lagna Scorpio) with part of Aries in chalit; the Aries 7th rule fires at a partial share.
Derived: 7th in Pisces (lagna Virgo) with part of Aries in chalit; Aries share activates the Saturn and Moon rule.

classical_check: Silent for the specific Aries-share rule; the use of chalit is classical.

hindi: यानी कि आपका सात नंबर या आठ नंबर का लग्न है तो यहां एक और दो आने के संकेत आ जाते हैं
says: If the lagna is sign 7 (Libra) or sign 8 (Scorpio), the 7th house carries signs 1 and 2 (Aries and Taurus), so both of his bad-sign patterns can come into the 7th.

Derived: Libra share of the lagna; the same house is judged under his sign-1 rule.
