classical_check: Arithmetic is correct: Virgo lagna has Pisces as 7th, Libra lagna has Aries.

hindi: चंद्रमा य बैठा है तो तलाक होगा दिखने को दिखेगा चंद्रमा 12 नंबर का है पर ऐसे व्यक्ति का तलाक होगा 100%
says: If the Moon sits in this 7th house that shares signs 12 and 1, divorce will happen; the Moon may look like a sign-12 Moon, but because the house also holds sign 1, such a person's divorce is certain in his words, 100 percent.
cells_derived_method: Moon in the 7th with a Pisces D1 label but an Aries share in chalit or sharing. Apply the Moon-in-Aries danger at the Aries share.

Derived: Moon in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra); the straightforward sign-1 case.

classical_check: Silent; the 100 percent claim is not supported in the classics.

says: If Saturn is the one sitting in this 7th house, the same result follows: divorce; observe the exact placement carefully.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in the 7th with an Aries share (sign 1 or 12/1 shared house).

Derived: Saturn in Pisces in the 7th (lagna Virgo) with an Aries share; the divorce claim fires on the share.

gist: Observation is very important; it matters a lot.

hindi: दो नंबर राशि यहां पर है तो दो नंबर में आपका सूर्य खराब है नीच तुल्य ही काम करेगा ये नीच ही है सत्यानाश करेगा ही करेगा
says: If sign 2 (Taurus) is in the 7th house, the Sun is bad in it, acts like a debilitated Sun and will ruin the marriage.
cells_derived_method: Taurus in the 7th means the lagna is Scorpio. The Sun there is lord of the 10th in the 7th, so it also harms the career-marriage link.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio); ego clash with spouse, career lord in an enemy sign.
Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 10th (lagna Leo); lagna lord in Venus's sign, status gained but pride is disturbed.
Derived: Sun in Taurus in the 4th (lagna Aquarius); home and father's property strained.

hindi: आपका यह चंद्रमा यहां लाजवाब काम करेगा अगर यहां दो नंबर का चंद्रमा पड़ा है

hindi: राशि आपकी घूम गई यानी कि यहां आठ नंबर था लेकिन 7/8 काम कर रही है तो ये उच्च है यह नीच भी हो गया शादी करके तलाक भी नहीं होने देगा और सारी जिंदगी खून के आसू रो
says: If the house shares signs so that the Moon is both in sign 2 (exalted) and counted in sign 8 (debilitated) because a 7/8 lagna is working, the Moon is exalted and debilitated together; the marriage will not end in divorce, yet he will weep blood tears all his life.
cells_derived_method: Moon at the border of Taurus and Scorpio shares in chalit; both dignities apply: marriage holds but without joy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) with part of the house in Scorpio; stuck marriage.

hindi: तीन नंबर हो गया य केतु नीच का है

cells_derived_method: Gemini in the 7th means the lagna is Sagittarius. Ketu's debilitation in Gemini is his stated scheme and applies in any house, with the house deciding what suffers.

Derived: Ketu in Gemini in the 4th (lagna Pisces); home and mother detachment, aspecting the 8th and 10th.
Derived: Ketu in Gemini in the 10th (lagna Virgo); career confusion and detachment from status.

Derived: Ketu in Sagittarius in the 1st (lagna Sagittarius) casts a 7th aspect on Gemini in the 7th.

hindi: केतु यहां से भी दृष्टि खराब दे रहा है यहां बैठा तलाक कराएगा शादी नहीं होने देगा
says: Ketu casts a bad aspect from still another place, and Ketu seated in the 7th itself will bring divorce and prevent marriage from happening.

Derived: Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius) with Ketu influence from the next sign; divorce signal.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर ये तीन नंबर आपकी राशि में भी शेयरिंग आ रही है कभी ना कभी दो नंबर में आ गई तीन नंबर में आ गई

hindi: आपको भी एक गुरु बाहर ढूंढना पड़ेगा एक गुरु मींस गाइड कोई बताने समझाने वाला करेक्शन क्या करनी है कैसे करनी है और उसे फॉलो करने की ताकत आप में होनी चाहिए
says: Because the cause is an external factor, you must find an outside guru or guide who tells you what correction to do and how, and you must have the strength to follow it.
classical_check: Classical remedial advice also asks for a guru; silent on any measurable rule.

hindi: श्रद्धा ताकि कनेक्टिविटी स्ट्रांग रहे अगर कनेक्टिविटी नहीं होगी तो हाथ छूट जाएगा डूब जाओगे यह तो गांठ बांध लो
says: Faith (shraddha) in the guide keeps the connection strong; without that connection the guide's hand slips and you sink, so tie this knot firmly.
classical_check: Classical tradition agrees that remedies need faith; this is not a computable rule.

hindi: अगर आपके जीवन में कोई लफड़ा है तो इसका मतलब आपका ब्रेन वो गाड़ी नहीं चला पा रहा आपके शरीर में को लफड़ा है तो इसका मतलब आपका ब्रेन उसको कहना मना नहीं पा रहा
says: His model: a mess in life means your brain is failing to steer the vehicle, and a problem in the body means your brain cannot make the body obey. This is a general mind-first claim, not a medical diagnosis rule.
ambiguity: Caption around the words for body and obey is garbled; meaning inferred.
classical_check: Not found in classical texts; modern psychological framing. Flagged as not a medical claim.

hindi: फॉल्ट आए दूसरे से ब्रेन ले लो उधार ले लो कि भाई तू बता दे दोस्त बता दे गुरु बता दे गुरु मित्र कहा जाता है इसको फ्रेंडशिप क्लास की हमने

classical_check: Silent; a counselling idea, not a chart rule.

gist: Says for that you need guidance and remedies, and he will cover what kind of remedies later.

hindi: वो सेम नहीं है वो अलग ही होता है वो दिखने को दिख रहा है
says: Even if a few planets appear in the same house or sign in parent and child charts, the charts are not the same; they are different and the similarity is only apparent.
ambiguity: Opening words are garbled in the caption.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical view that the whole chart, not a single placement, gives results; no specific text.

hindi: चौथा बृहस्पति है उससे क्या फर्क है वो तो लाखों लोगों का है अरबों का है 12 राशि 12 किस्म के लोग हो फिर तो धरती पर अलग अलग किस्म के क्यों है
says: Jupiter in the 4th house is shared by millions of people; if one placement decided character there would be only 12 kinds of people on earth, yet people differ widely, so a single planet's house cannot define a person.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in the 4th is the same house for any lagna, but the sign changes with lagna and the 4th house topics (home, mother, vehicle, peace) mix with sign nature, so the reading differs across the twelve lagnas.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in Aries in 4th means lagna Capricorn; Jupiter sits in the friendly fire sign of Mars, giving an energetic, ambitious but somewhat restless home life.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in Cancer in 4th means lagna Aries; exalted Jupiter in the house of home gives a strong, comfortable home base.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in Capricorn in 4th means lagna Libra; debilitated Jupiter in the house of home reduces ease and comfort at home.

ambiguity: Caption says 'fourth Jupiter'; could be Jupiter in the 4th house or Jupiter in the fourth sign Cancer (exalted). Taken as 4th house.
classical_check: Classical texts agree that single placements are modified by sign, aspects and lordship.

hindi: वो दिख रहे हैं कि चार ग्रह देख लिए अगर एक ग्रह भी बदल गया सब कुछ बदल गया
says: Looking at four matching planets is not enough; if even one planet differs, everything about the chart changes.
classical_check: Consistent with holistic chart reading; no exact classical statement.

hindi: ट्विंस की कुंडली के अंदर डिग्री बदल जाती है चलित बदल जाता है निर भाव चला बदल जाता है केपी बदल जाता है एक राशि खिसक जाती है
says: Twins have different charts: the degrees differ, the bhava chalit changes, the nirayana bhava chalit changes, KP changes, and some placement slips into the next sign.
ambiguity: The phrase 'nir bhava chala' is garbled; likely nirayana bhava chalit or a second chalit variant.
classical_check: Classical texts support birth-time sensitivity (divisional charts and lagna degree change in minutes); agrees.

hindi: ये हिप्नोसिस है ये एक बिलीफ फेथ सिस्टम है हम सब एक हिप्नोसिस में जीते हैं हमारे जीवन के अंदर जैसा हिप्नोसिस हमारे अंदर पिरो दिया जाए वैसा हम बन जाते हैं

hindi: अब शनि की साढ़े साती के लिए हमारा एक बिलीफ सिस्टम बना रखा है शनि की साढ़े साती ओ माय गॉड आपकी लंका लगेगी आपको पता ही नहीं
says: Society has built a fear-based belief system around Saturn's sade sati (the seven and a half year period when Saturn passes through the Moon sign and the signs on either side); people expect ruin.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in Cancer in 10th means lagna Libra; sade sati runs while Saturn is in Gemini, Cancer and Leo and the career house carries the strain.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in Aries in 4th means lagna Capricorn; sade sati runs while Saturn is in Pisces, Aries and Taurus and home and mother matters are tested.

classical_check: Sade sati as a Moon-sign transit period is standard in later Jyotish; early texts (BPHS) do not name it as a dosha.

hindi: वट शनि की साढ़े साती आपका कुछ नहीं होगा

hindi: श्रीराम की भी राशि तुला थी रावण की राशि भी तुला थी चंद्रमा सेम राशि का था
says: He claims Shri Ram and Ravana both had Libra as their moon sign, so they shared the same sade sati timing.

hindi: साढ़ाई कृष्ण की राशि भी सेम मिथुन थी

hindi: कंस की राशि भी वही थी करको तो वो सेम राशि थी इनकी और दोनों के साथ साढ़े साती इकट्ठा आई थी

Derived, not said by him: Moon in Gemini in 2nd means lagna Taurus; the stress falls on money, family and speech.

hindi: तो शनि ने क्या किया एक के साथ प्लस माइनस ऐसा नहीं है इट इज ऑल अबाउट द फेथ सिस्टम

hindi: हमने अभी देखा कि किस प्रकार आप कौन सा ग्रह क्या लेते हैं किस तरह इफेक्ट लेते हैं

says: Restating the question: sade sati goes well for some people and badly for others, and one should see it that way.

hindi: मांगेराम और मुना को एक साथ शनि की साढ़े सती आएगी अब दोनों की राशि के अंदर दोनों का कर्म क्या है

hindi: पत्नी ने उसमें से नोट मार लिए उसने शनि का कर्म नष्ट कर दिया अब उसको साढ़े साती सत्यानाश करेगी

hindi: मांगेराम की मौज चलेगी और वो अपना कोटा खत्म कर देगी पति की जेब का और धीरे-धीरे पति से दूर हो जाएगी

hindi: इसीलिए आपका कर्म डिसाइड करेगा आपकी साढ़े साती क्या करेगी
says: His conclusion: your own karma decides what your sade sati will do to you, not the transit itself.

hindi: इससे टोटली अनवेयर रहो परमात्मा पर छोड़ो

hindi: हम मंगलवार को नहीं खाएंगे नॉनवेज हनुमान जी का इतना ही आदर है सिर्फ मंगलवार को नॉनवेज नहीं खाओगे मत खाओ ना फिर सारे हफ्ते पूरे जन्म मत खाओ

hindi: बाकी घसिया रहे हैं बुधवार का माता का है

hindi: दूसरा आपके घर के अंदर वेस्ट नॉर्थ वेस्ट डिस्टर्ब है वहां का देवता होता है शोष जो आंखें के पानी को सुखाता है आंखों के अंतर्गत आपकी ड्राइनेस देता है
says: Second cause: the west or north-west of your home is disturbed; the vastu deity there is Shosha who dries the water of the eyes and gives eye dryness.
ambiguity: Whether he means the west zone, the north-west zone or the pada between them is not clear.
classical_check: Shosha is a pada of the vastu mandala on the west side close to the north-west corner; broadly agrees.

gist: Says a medicine contains sulphur but he will not say more; a medical aside.
Says 'hold the drink, hold the drink' about reducing the spectacle number, a stray remark.
Says astigmatism needs a good doctor and he should not be asked for medical directions without fees.

hindi: मुझे आपने फीस नहीं दी है ट्रांजैक्शन पूरी नहीं होगी यह गहराई समझो यह ट्रांजैक्शन है
says: Claims remedies and advice work only when an exchange is completed: since you have not paid him a fee the transaction is not complete, and this deeper idea of transaction is the core of karma.
ambiguity: Partly a statement about his own fee.
classical_check: Daan and dakshina to a guru are classical, so broadly agrees.

gist: Old-days story: a daughter-in-law cooked for the house and the elder gave her some money to close the transaction, calling it 'fifty'.

hindi: ये टोटका है ऐसे नहीं होता है कि हमने गाय कुत्ते कवे की रोटी निकाली ये ट्रांजैक्शन पूरी करो कर्जई रह जाओगे दूसरे के कई जन्मों तक
says: Feeding bread to the cow, dog and crow is just a trick (totka) and does not by itself settle anything; you must complete the real transaction or you remain indebted to the other person for many births.
classical_check: Differs from the common practice of cow-dog-crow offerings as pitru remedies.

gist: Jokes about how much he has told the audience and asks God to bear it for many births.
Next participant is invited to ask; asks whether some stone helps bad eyesight and refers to the earlier belief-system point.
Says people see the problem, wear a stone, and still keep using mobiles and doing wrong things, so belief persists.

hindi: स्टोन का आंखों से कोई लेनदेन नहीं किसी उपाय का आंख से लेन देन नहीं है
says: A gemstone has no dealing with the eyes, and no remedy (upaya) has any dealing with eyesight; remedies cannot be used as an eye cure.
ambiguity: He rejects stones for eyes here but later gives threads for debilitated planets near the eyes.
classical_check: Differs from gem-therapy texts which prescribe a Sun or Moon stone for the eyes.

hindi: आप अपने टिंकू के द्वारा प्रारब्ध को ठीक करेंगे या आपके ग्रह में लिखा ही है आंख की प्रॉब्लम आएगी
says: Asks whether you can fix prarabdha (fixed past-life karma) yourself, or whether the chart already has it written that an eye problem will come; implies such a defect is destiny and cannot be removed by small acts.
ambiguity: The word 'Tinku' is a garble or a nickname; meaning inferred from the rest of the sentence.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea of prarabdha being written in the chart.

gist: Notes the talk has drifted to eyes when the earlier subject was marriage, and says he took a different path.

hindi: यह आपकी एक आंख है दूसरी आंख है एक आंख दूसरी आंख ये ज्यादा इंपॉर्टेंट है
says: Pointing to the chart, he says there are two eye positions, one for each eye, and that one of them is more important than the other.
ambiguity: He points at the chart without naming houses; a later chunk names the 2nd and 12th, which are assumed here. Which eye is more important is not heard.
classical_check: Agrees: the 2nd house is the right eye and the 12th the left eye in classical texts.

hindi: अगर यहां पर मान लो चंद्रमा आपका नीच का बैठा है दृष्टि है तो ये एक आंख गई
says: If a debilitated Moon sits in the eye position (or aspects it), that one eye is lost; he states it as a tradition claim, not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The Moon is debilitated in Scorpio; the effect shifts with the eye house it lands in: the 2nd house (right eye side) or 12th house (left eye side), and with the lagna that results.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: debilitated Moon in Scorpio in 2nd means lagna Libra; the Moon weakens the right-eye house and the family and speech themes.
Derived, not said by him: debilitated Moon in Scorpio in 12th means lagna Sagittarius; the left-eye house and the house of loss both carry the weak Moon.

ambiguity: The house is only shown as 'here' on the chart; Scorpio is the sign of Moon's debilitation, not named by him.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: afflicted luminaries and the 2nd and 12th houses indicate eye troubles.

hindi: आपका यहां शनि बैठा नीच का एक आंख गई ऑप्टिक वेन के अंदर ब्लड सप्लाई खत्म कर देता है शनि
says: A debilitated Saturn sitting in the eye position also costs one eye by cutting the blood supply in the optic vein; this is his tradition claim, not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Saturn is debilitated in Aries; the house decides which eye side and which life theme is hurt along with the eye.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: debilitated Saturn in Aries in 2nd means lagna Pisces; the right-eye house and family wealth house are squeezed.
Derived, not said by him: debilitated Saturn in Aries in 12th means lagna Taurus; the left-eye house plus the house of loss and hospitals are squeezed.

ambiguity: The house is only shown as 'here' on the chart, and the sign Aries is inferred from 'neech' for Saturn.
classical_check: Saturn debilitated in Aries is standard; its link to optic blood supply is not classical.

hindi: अगर शनि का दूसरे घर से दृष्टि का लिंक है आपकी नाक की हड्डी टेढ़ी होगी गर्दन के पीछे तिल होगा
says: If Saturn links by aspect to the 2nd house, the nose bone will be crooked and there will be a mole at the back of the neck; physical-sign claim from tradition, not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Saturn aspects the 3rd, 7th and 10th from itself, so it links to the 2nd house from the 12th, the 8th or the 5th, and also by conjunction in the 2nd; the sign changes the strength of the link.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Aquarius in 12th means lagna Pisces; its third aspect falls on the 2nd house, a strong own-sign link.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Capricorn in 8th means lagna Gemini; its seventh aspect falls on the 2nd house from its own sign.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Scorpio in 5th means lagna Cancer; its tenth aspect falls on the 2nd house from a friendly Mars sign.

ambiguity: 'Drishti ka link' may mean any aspect or conjunction; I took Saturn's special aspects.
classical_check: Physical signs for Saturn on the 2nd are a samudrika-style claim; classical texts are silent on nose bone and neck mole.

gist: Asks why he is telling these things, says they are fun, and keeps them for next week.

hindi: आपके लाइफ के अंदर आपके आइज के लिए दूसरा और 12वां घर सेट रखना बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी है अगर ये सेट रहेंगे आपकी आइज ठीक रहेंगी अदर वाइज आपकी आंख जाएगी ही जाएगी
says: For eyesight, the 2nd and 12th houses must be kept in order; if they are well set the eyes stay fine, otherwise sight will be lost; flagged as a strong tradition claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Both houses are multi-sign; for each lagna the 2nd and 12th are different signs with different lords, so the check is on those lords and signs, not on one sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mercury in Virgo in 2nd means lagna Leo; for a Leo lagna the 2nd house is Virgo and the 12th is Cancer, so Mercury and Moon status decide the eyes.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in Pisces in 12th means lagna Aries; the 12th house is Pisces and the 2nd is Taurus, so Jupiter and Venus status decide the eyes.

classical_check: Agrees on 2nd and 12th as eye houses; 'will surely be lost' is stronger than any classical text.

hindi: इसी के लिए आपके डायरेक्शंस भी है घर के वो भी डिस्टर्ब होते हैं तब ऐसा होता है तो ये मल्टीपल रीजन है
says: The home directions (vastu) also matter for eyes; when they are disturbed alongside the chart defects, the eye trouble shows, so it has multiple reasons together.
classical_check: Vastu-chart link is a modern combination, silent in classical Jyotish.

hindi: इसमें उपाय करके इसको डाइल्यूशन करके हल्का किया जाता है
says: Remedies do not remove such a defect; they only dilute it and make it lighter.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical view that remedies pacify but cannot cancel prarabdha.

hindi: नीच के ग्रह होते हैं तो राइट पैर में एक धागा डालते हैं जिस ग्रह की दृष्टि से यहां करेक्शन हो और लेफ्ट वाले पैर में दूसरा कलर का धागा डालते हैं
says: Thread remedy for debilitated planets: tie a thread on the right foot in the colour of the planet whose aspect corrects the spot, and a thread of a second colour on the left foot for the planets of the eye, throat, head and neck region.
cells_derived_method: The thread colours depend on which planets aspect the weak spot and which planets sit in the eye, throat, head and neck houses; no colours are given here.
ambiguity: No colour is named for any planet; the chunk ends the sentence with the left-foot purpose.
classical_check: Foot threads are a folk remedy; not in classical texts.

hindi: जिससे यहां के ग्रह इस आंख को गले को सिर को गर्दन को सबको सेट करके रखे
says: The second thread is meant so that the planets in those places keep the eye, throat, head and neck in good order.
ambiguity: This is the tail of the previous sentence and repeats its purpose.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Garbled phrase about your 'bed comforts' being disturbed.

hindi: सिर्फ एक धागा पहनने मात्र से करेक्शन हो जाती है वेस्टेज ऑफ फंड्स व्यसन बर्बादी सारी करेक्शन हो जाती
says: Merely wearing one such thread corrects things like wasteful spending, addictions and ruin, and the correction happens fully.

hindi: है करेक्शन ठीक डिपेंड करता है सारी कुंडली अलाव करती है कि नहीं करती अदर वाइज नहीं होगा उपाय की एक लिमिट है
says: Whether the correction works depends on whether the whole chart allows it; if not, nothing happens, so every remedy has a limit.
classical_check: Agrees with the view that remedies work only as far as the chart permits.

hindi: ये एनर्जी बॉडी का खेल है मेरे आपके अंदर एनर्जी बॉडी चल रही है उस एनर्जी बॉडी के अंदर जान होनी चाहिए

ambiguity: The following word 'ra ki strength' is garbled and possibly means prana or Ra (Sun).
classical_check: Silent in classical Jyotish; an energy-body concept from his own framework.

hindi: जैसे आप मैं वजन उठा रहा हूं 100 किलो मेरे से उठ नहीं रहा मैं आपका हाथ लगाऊंगा उठ गया ऐसे किसी गुरु की मदद लेंगे रा दे दो गुरु क्योंकि वो उधर से लेना जानता है
says: By the weight-lifting analogy: one cannot lift the hundred kilos alone but lifts it with a helping hand, so you take the guru's help to borrow energy because he knows how to draw it from the source.
ambiguity: The word before 'de do guru' is garbled and might be 'Ra' (energy) rather than Rahu.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with the earlier call to find a guru.

Participant starts a question about feeling helpless and fearful in Rahu mahadasha.
Participant continues: depression is felt, will these symptoms last until the mahadasha ends.

hindi: बेबसी आपको महसूस होगी 18 के 18 साल में वो आपको तोड़ के रखेगा इसलिए 18 साल बेबस रहो
says: During Rahu mahadasha you will feel helpless through all eighteen years of the dasha; Rahu keeps you broken, so be prepared to remain helpless for the full period. This is a tradition claim, not a mental-health diagnosis.
ambiguity: The sentence is also his answer to the question of how long the symptoms will last.
classical_check: Rahu mahadasha is 18 years in Vimshottari; its general trouble is classical, but the claim of constant helplessness is his.

hindi: एक्सेप्ट करते ही मुन्ना बदल देता है सब कुछ शनि है जो एक्सेप्ट किया बदल देगा
says: Acceptance changes everything immediately; Saturn is the planet of acceptance, so what you accept he will change.
ambiguity: 'Munna' is a garbled word; the rest of the sentence is clear.
classical_check: Saturn as karaka of patience and acceptance is standard.

hindi: परमात्मा की कृपा रही शनि महाराज ने करवा दी तो फट से बदल जाता है और यह बदलते ही राहु बदलते ही आपके 18 साल आप ज्ञानी होंगे परम पुरुष
says: If by God's grace Saturn brings about the acceptance, things flip quickly; once Rahu's energy turns, the eighteen years make you a wise, supreme person.
classical_check: Silent on this; it matches classical Rahu as a teacher for the prepared native.

hindi: नहीं तो आप कुड़े सड़े हुए रोते पिटते पूरे जन्म कोसने और रोने वाले बनोगे इसलिए राहु की महादशा बेबस तो कराएगी
says: If acceptance does not come, you become rotten and bitter, crying and cursing for life; Rahu's mahadasha will certainly bring helplessness in either case.
classical_check: Differs slightly from classical charts where Rahu dasha can give success by house and sign.

hindi: पूजा पाठ अंतर दशा भी पूजा पाठ बंद कर दो बिल्कुल बंद मंदिर बंद कर दो पितरों को याद करो पितृ कृपा लो
says: Remedy in Rahu mahadasha and in its antardashas: stop puja-path and temple visits entirely, remember the ancestors instead and take pitru grace.
ambiguity: 'Antar dasha bhi' could mean all sub-periods inside Rahu dasha or Rahu's own antardasha elsewhere.
classical_check: Differs from classical advice to do Durga or Shiva worship for Rahu.

hindi: अपने हाथ से अल्कोहल दान करो बांटो बियर बांटो बियर इज वेरी प्रोडक्टिव बियर बांटो शराब बांटो
says: Rahu remedy: donate alcohol with your own hand, distribute beer or liquor; he says beer is very productive. This is a tradition claim and not advice to drink.
classical_check: Alcohol donation is a known folk Rahu remedy (as in some Kaal Bhairav practices) but is not in BPHS.

hindi: यह बांटो गिफ्ट नहीं करनी अनजान को देनी है
says: The alcohol is to be given away, not gifted to someone you know; it must go to an unknown person.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जो चीज देने के बाद लेने वाले को पता नहीं किसने दी और देने वाले ने घमंड नहीं किया मैंने दिया वही काउंट होगा राहु के दान में
says: In Rahu's donation only that gift counts where the receiver does not know who gave it and the giver has no pride of having given.
ambiguity: Starts with a lead-in 'maje ki baat' from the previous chunk.
classical_check: Anonymous donation (gupta daan) is classical for Rahu and Ketu; agrees.

hindi: कहीं आप सोचो मैंने दोस्तों को बोतलें दे दी बड़ी बढ़िया मजा आ गया बिजनेस कॉन्ट्रैक्ट मिलेंगे डंडे पड़ेंगे बेबस हो जाओगे राहु सब पी जाएगा
says: Warning: if you give bottles to friends and expect business contracts you will instead get beaten and become helpless, because Rahu drinks up everything given with expectation.
ambiguity: 'Free' at the end of the line is a stray caption word.
classical_check: Silent; it follows from the anonymity rule of Rahu's donation.

gist: Participant asks whether the pension an unmarried daughter gets from her late father's job can be called pitru kripa.

hindi: उस लड़की की अगर शादी नहीं हुई है तो पित्र कृपा तो उस पर नहीं है बस समझो पिताजी का आशीर्वाद है कि बच्ची मेरी पल जाए पता नहीं कौन सी कमांड पापा ने दे रखी होगी
says: For an unmarried daughter living on her father's pension, it is not pitru kripa but only the father's blessing or a command he left that his child be looked after.

classical_check: Silent; a distinction made in his framework.

hindi: उस लड़की के जीवन में पिता का सुख नहीं है जरूर भाई का भी सुख नहीं होगा इसलिए पति का भी नहीं है इसलिए पुत्र का भी नहीं होगा यह दोष है
says: Such a girl lacks a father's happiness, so she will surely lack a brother's, a husband's and a son's happiness too; he calls this a dosha chain among male relations.

hindi: बृहस्पति डैमेज है इस बालिका का बृहस्पति डैमेज है
says: Diagnoses the girl's cause as damaged Jupiter, the karaka of husband and children for a woman.

classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is the husband and children karaka for women.

hindi: जो इस प्रकार पिता के द्वारा पल रही है सूर्य बृहस्पति की हेल्प है बृहस्पति अस्त भी है और शायद वक्री भी हो सकता है अस्त तो पक्का है
says: Her being supported by her father shows help from Sun and Jupiter, but Jupiter is combust (certain) and maybe retrograde, which damages it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Sun and combust Jupiter in Sagittarius in 7th means lagna Gemini; the partnership house loses the husband karaka's strength.
Derived, not said by him: Sun and combust Jupiter in Leo in 5th means lagna Aries; the child house is overshadowed by the father's Sun.

ambiguity: The sentence ends at the start of the next chunk with 'pakka hai' (it is certain).
classical_check: Agrees that combust Jupiter is weakened; combustion orb for Jupiter is about 11 degrees.

gist: Question is posed on how people become satisfied (tript) when things obtained leave one wanting again.

hindi: तृप्त होना एनर्जी बॉडी का काम है और जो सेटिस्फाइड होना है वो फिजिकल बॉडी का काम है
says: True contentment (tripti) belongs to the energy body, while mere satisfaction belongs to the physical body.

says: Whatever you eat, drink or do, the body asks again for more because that is the body's hunger and not true contentment.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तृप्त का मतलब आपका यह हुआ कि आप एनर्जी बॉडी को यह 4 पर बॉडी ब्रेन का खेल है जो हमारा स्वयं है तृप्ति 4 पर होती है

hindi: ये सारा का सारा नियो कॉर्टेक्स डेवलप होने से पहले होगा 25 साल की उम्र से पहले जब तक आपका ये एक्टिवेट नहीं हुआ
says: Training and conditioning take effect fully only before the neocortex develops, that is before about age 25, while one's own mind is not yet activated.
classical_check: Neocortex is a modern term; age 25 resembles classical maturity ages for Venus (25) but he links it to the brain.

hindi: जो सूर्य है वो 10 तक चलता है
says: The Sun's influence period in a person's early life runs up to age 10.
ambiguity: The number 10 may be a caption error for 22, the classical Sun maturity age.
classical_check: Differs: classical planetary maturity age for the Sun is 22.

hindi: सूर्य 10 की ऐज तक जाएगा चंद्रमा पांच मंगल 27 बृहस्पति 16 बुध 32 है
says: Gives each planet's age span for shaping a child: Sun to 10, Moon 5, Mars 27, Jupiter 16, Mercury 32.
ambiguity: Sun 10 and Moon 5 look like caption errors or a different scheme; Mars 27 is close to the classical 28.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter 16 and Mercury 32 match classical maturity ages; Sun (22), Moon (24) and Mars (28) differ.

hindi: बृहस्पति 16 ये हो गया गुरु महाराज 16 की ऐज के प्लस माइनस 5 साल के अंदर आप जो भी बच्चे के अंदर फीडिंग करते हो वो उस तरफ जाता है
says: Jupiter's age is 16; within about five years either side of it, whatever you feed into a child sets the direction the child will take.
ambiguity: Plus or minus 5 years gives ages 11 to 21.
classical_check: Jupiter maturity at age 16 is classical; the window of plus or minus five is his.

hindi: इसलिए 16 से पहले बच्चे को बिगाड़ो संत बनाओ आतंकवादी बनाओ जो मर्जी करो 25 तक पूर्ण रूप से उसको वैसा नक्शा बना सकते हो उसके बॉडी ब्रेन का
says: Before 16, and fully up to 25, you can mould a child's body-brain as you like, as saint or as terrorist, because the pattern is not yet fixed.
classical_check: Differs from fixed-destiny readings; consistent with Jupiter's early-life influence.

hindi: 25 के बाद उसके अपने ग्रह जागृत हो जाते हैं अपनी बुद्धि चलने लग जाती है तो नियो कोटेक्स अपने आप फैसले लेता है
says: After 25 the person's own planets awaken, own intelligence starts working, and the neocortex makes its own decisions.
classical_check: Silent; compare Venus maturity at 25 in classical lists.

hindi: लेकिन बॉडी ब्रेन जो ट्रेंड हो चुका है वो हो चुका है
says: Whatever the body-brain was trained to do earlier stays fixed even after the neocortex starts deciding; it does not get undone.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Cites the Jason Bourne film where the hero forgets his identity but his body remains trained.

hindi: इसलिए कई जन्मों के पश्चात भी हमारी बॉडी भोजन करना खाना पीना यूरिन एक्सक्रीट करना यह भूलता नहीं है
says: Even after many births the body does not forget basic functions like eating, drinking and excreting, showing that the body carries memory across lives.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with samskara carried across births.

hindi: यह बॉडी के अंदर फीडेड है प्रीलोडेड मेमरी है
says: Those basic functions are fed and preloaded memory inside the body, installed before this birth.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जो बन गया वो पढ़ा लिखा की लड़ाई नहीं है उसके ग्रह में लिखा है कि पढ़े और जाए वही जाना है
says: Using the so-called IIT Baba as an example: becoming a sadhu after higher studies is not about education; it was written in his planets that he would study and then go that way.
ambiguity: The name of the person and the first half of the sentence are garbled in the caption.
classical_check: Agrees that destiny can override education; no specific rule.

hindi: जब पंचम भाव पर शनि की दृष्टि होती है जैसे शनि ले रहे हम तो बच्चा जो उसका लाभ ही नहीं उठा पाता पूरे जन्म
says: When Saturn aspects the 5th house, the child cannot take the benefit of what the 5th house gives, for the whole life.
cells_derived_method: Saturn aspects the 3rd, 7th and 10th from itself, so it falls on the 5th from the 3rd, the 11th or the 8th; the sign decides the strength and the lagna decides the lord of the 5th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Capricorn in 3rd means lagna Scorpio; its third aspect hits the 5th house, Pisces, of Jupiter.
Derived, not said by him: exalted Saturn in Libra in 11th means lagna Sagittarius; its seventh aspect hits the 5th house, Aries.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Aquarius in 8th means lagna Cancer; its tenth aspect hits the 5th house, Scorpio.

ambiguity: It is unclear whether 'benefit' refers to education, talent or children.
classical_check: Saturn's aspect on the 5th giving delays in education and children is classical; 'whole life' is stronger.

hindi: शादी करी सप्तम भाव में शनि पत्नी का लाभ नहीं होगा पति पति का लाभ नहीं होगा तलाक होगा फिर जाओ बाहर
says: If Saturn sits in the 7th house, you get no benefit from the wife or husband, a divorce follows, and the person moves out.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in the 7th takes a different sign with each lagna: exalted in Libra, debilitated in Aries, own sign in Capricorn, so the strength of the divorce effect changes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn exalted in Libra in 7th means lagna Aries; strong Saturn gives a durable but heavy marriage rather than a quick break.
Derived, not said by him: debilitated Saturn in Aries in 7th means lagna Libra; the sharpest case for marital distress and separation.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in own Capricorn in 7th means lagna Cancer; a controlled, delayed partnership.

classical_check: Agrees that Saturn in the 7th delays or troubles marriage; divorce is an extreme reading.

hindi: आपने जरा सा खुशी मना ली नजर लग गई यह शनि है पति के साथ बहुत अच्छे दिन चल रहे लड़ाई शुरू जैसे ही आपने कह दिया बहुत खराब दिन चल रहे हैं प्यार शुरू
says: Saturn reverses what you proclaim: celebrate a good phase and a fight starts as if by evil eye; call it a bad phase and love starts.
classical_check: Silent; a behavioural description of Saturn's nature.

hindi: रिवर्सल का देवता ये अंधकार में रखता है ना

ambiguity: The words 'ye shani hai' before it are stray; the line is a short remark about Saturn.

gist: Announces only two questions are left; first one asks, in English, what role astrology and planets play if one rises to higher chakras through consciousness, and whether the two are independent or linked.
Participant finishes the question about a person who rises to higher chakras by mentality and whether astrology and planets are left.

hindi: यह कुंडली में योग होगा भैया कि वो कृपा लेने ऊपर जाता है कि नहीं जाता पांचवें और नौवें घर का कार्यक्रम होगा
says: Whether a person can go up to receive grace is itself a yoga in the chart; it is a matter of the 5th and 9th houses.
cells_derived_method: Each of the 5th and 9th houses is multi-sign, so the lagna decides which signs and lords carry the yoga.
classical_check: Agrees that the 5th and 9th (trikona) govern merit and grace.

hindi: उच्च का ग्रह होगा पांचवें सातवें नौवें में तभी यह काम हो सकता है
says: This rise can happen only if an exalted planet sits in the 5th, 7th or 9th house.
cells_derived_method: The exalted planet must be in its own exaltation sign, so for each house the lagna that gives that exact placement differs.

ambiguity: He names the 7th here though the next sentences speak of 5th and 9th only.
classical_check: Exalted planets in trikona or kendra give raja-yoga-like grace; no text ties this to rising chakras.

classical_check: Silent; a strong negative claim.

hindi: इसीलिए हम कहते हैं गुरु लोन पर ले लो पितरों से उधार ले लो अन्यथा असंभव है
says: Therefore take a guru on loan and borrow grace from the ancestors; otherwise the higher rise is impossible.
classical_check: Silent; matches the guru and pitru emphasis earlier in this lecture.

hindi: यह आपका पंचम भाव है और यह नवम भाव यह आप हो यह पांचवा भाव है यह हमारा बच्चा यह हमारा पिता

hindi: तो पित्र जो पैदा होने वाले हैं और जो हो चुके हैं यह सारे के सारे यही है

says: Grace lives in these two houses; if an exalted planet acts on them, everything comes to you without effort, and you need not study.

hindi: सारा खेल ही कृपा का भाई इस घर को सेट करो आपका यहां सेटिंग हो गई पढ़ने लिखने की जरूरत नहीं है

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मैंने इतनी मेहनत करी फिर रिजल्ट कहां है रिजल्ट का ग्रह नहीं है यहां उच्च की दृष्टि ग्रह की होगी आपको लाभ होगा

classical_check: Agrees that exalted planet aspects bring gains; no text says effort becomes irrelevant.

hindi: आपके पास उड़ के ज्ञान आएगा कैसे होगा ये आप करोगे प्रत्यक्ष आएगा यह सीखना पड़ेगा आपको
says: With grace, knowledge flies to you; how this happens is not explained now and will be learned by direct practice.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जब कृपा मिल जाती है तो आपके ग्रही आपको ऊपर के चक्कर पर ले जाते हैं
says: Once grace arrives, your own planets lift you to the higher chakra level, so planets and the higher path work together.
ambiguity: This is his answer to the participant's question about whether planets and chakras are separate.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब ये समझ आ चुका है कैसे आती है यही पाथवे आपको सीखना है जब आप सीख लोगे काम खत्म बहुत आसान है
says: Understanding how grace arrives is the pathway you have to learn; once learned the work is finished and it is very easy.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जब उस कृपा से सीख जाते हैं तभी अरबपति आदमी जिसके पास सिर्फ 24 ही घंटे होते हैं जीवन के अंदर टाइम नहीं होता ज्यादा

says: Within those 24 hours the billionaire gets multiple successes from these two places (the 5th and 9th houses), and a little work prints money because of supreme grace.

says: If he learns contentment (tripti) he draws more grace and blessings and increases the power of his energy body, not of his money.
classical_check: Silent.

says: People busy increasing money let their energy body shrink; the right way will be taught in later classes.

hindi: सातवें घर का राहु चंद्रमा होगा और मां पर बच्चे की कुंडली का असर होगा
